A glowing neon-blue square portal frame grows rapidly larger, centered directly below him. Camera: a vertical top-down POV chase-cam, diving straight down in perfect sync with his fall, creating a vertigo-inducing straight-down perspective the entire beat. Audio: rushing wind, a rising synth swell, a heartbeat-like bass pulse building tension toward the portal. (0:11–0:15) — The Landing: He drops through the glowing neon square portal and lands in a perfect crouched landing pose on a rooftop party space, instantly rising to full height with arms thrown open wide, confident triumphant expression. A crowd of stylish friends surrounding him erupts — cheering, clapping, some recording on phones, several rushing in to hug and swarm him. Camera: a static wide shot at ground level, the neon portal frame centered in the background, holding steady to let the crowd's energy and his landing read clearly with no camera movement — a deliberate stillness payoff after the vertiginous fall. Audio: music hits its full drop, crowd cheering and laughing, celebratory energy, quick overlapping voices. Overall: photorealistic, premium viral-commercial quality, a deliberately different camera angle per beat (low rear tracking → wide suspended shot → vertical POV dive → static landing wide), consistent cinematic color grade and film grain throughout, high contrast night lighting with neon accents, 9:16 vertical, no on-screen text, no watermark, no logos.

items.prompt: Dance rehearsal mini vlog created using Seedance 2.0 Prompt: Format: 16:9 Concept: "Behind the Choreography" Create a hyper-realistic self-recorded vlog filmed entirely on a modern flagship smartphone using the front-facing camera. The entire video is captured by the idol herself in one continuous take, creating an authentic behind-the-scenes experience. The footage should feel completely unscripted, with natural handheld movement, subtle smartphone stabilization, realistic autofocus breathing, automatic HDR exposure adjustments, occasional imperfect framing, and genuine ambient sound. No cinematic shots, jump cuts, transitions, slow motion, or stylized editing. Visual Style Modern smartphone video with crisp 4K detail, realistic HDR, balanced indoor lighting, true-to-life colours, natural skin texture, and clean image processing. No filters, no beauty mode, no film grain, and no artificial cinematic effects. It should look exactly like a real selfie vlog filmed on a flagship phone. Character YURI, a Korean female idol in her twenties with long black hair tied into a neat high ponytail, minimal rehearsal makeup, naturally glowing skin, and an energetic, cheerful personality. She wears realistic dance practice clothing: an oversized charcoal zip-up hoodie over a fitted black athletic top, loose grey sweatpants, white sneakers, and a smartwatch. During rehearsal, she removes the hoodie and ties it around her waist, matching a real dance studio environment. Location A professional K-pop dance practice studio with mirrored walls, polished wooden floors, ceiling speakers, bright rehearsal lighting, backpacks, water bottles, towels, portable fans, and dancers warming up naturally in the background. The recording starts just outside the practice room. YURI smiles at the phone. "Come with me... today you get to see what rehearsal actually looks like." She opens the studio door and walks inside, greeting the dancers with a quick wave before placing her backpack beside the mirror. She stretches while chatting casually to the camera. "Everyone sees the performance... but not this part." The music starts. She removes her hoodie, ties it around her waist, and joins the rehearsal. Between dance sections she briefly films herself catching her breath, laughing after making a small mistake, checking the choreography in the mirror, taking a quick sip of water, and celebrating when the team finally nails a difficult sequence. Breathing heavily but smiling, she looks into the camera. "We've been repeating this part forever... but it's finally coming together." The rehearsal finishes. The dancers applaud each other while packing their bags. YURI wipes away sweat with a towel, picks up her hoodie, and walks toward the exit. Before leaving, she turns the phone back to herself. "That's what happens before you ever see us on stage. Thanks for hanging out with me, see you at the performance." She smiles, waves, switches off the studio lights as she leaves, and the recording ends naturally. Generation Requirements One continuous uninterrupted recording with consistent facial identity, realistic dance movements, believable fatigue, natural eye contact, accurate mirror reflections, physically correct body mechanics, stable clothing continuity, authentic smartphone camera behaviour, realistic indoor acoustics, and no AI artifacts, warped anatomy, duplicated reflections, jump cuts, floating objects, or unnatural motion. The final result should be indistinguishable from a real K-pop idol's behind-the-scenes rehearsal vlog filmed on her own smartphone.

Hyper-realistic raw footage. Fast multi-shot storytelling across handheld, telephoto and deck cameras. STORY A carrier-based fighter returns over rough open water with an apparent mechanical problem. Crew clear the landing area as the fighter approaches and lands safely. 00–03s — EMERGENCY Wide handheld footage on an active carrier deck under heavy overcast skies. A fictional fighter approaches low over the ocean, landing gear down. Aircraft makes subtle roll and yaw corrections against turbulent air. Heat distortion behind engines. Camera operator struggles slightly to maintain framing. 06–09s — DECK SCRAMBLE Shoulder-mounted footage among crew. Personnel rapidly move equipment and take safe positions. One crew member crosses foreground, briefly blocking the lens. Camera pans toward the approaching fighter. Controlled professional urgency, no theatrical panic. 09–12s — TOUCHDOWN Low deck camera from a safe side position. Fighter touches down firmly. Landing gear compresses, tyres produce a small realistic puff, aircraft rapidly decelerates. Camera makes a fast imperfect pan following it. No explosion or exaggerated sparks. 12–15s — SAFE STOP Three-quarter handheld footage. Aircraft reaches a controlled stop, engine still running and heat haze visible. Crew cautiously approach, signal toward the cockpit and inspect the aircraft. Final frame holds briefly on the fighter surrounded by responding crew with rough ocean behind. Foreground obstruction. Autofocus corrections. Telephoto compression. Wind-induced micro-shake. Natural motion blur. Camera operators react to events rather than anticipating them. Crew clothing and straps react continuously to wind. Jet engines produce realistic heat distortion. Sound perspective changes naturally between shots. No cinematic soundtrack. VISUAL CHARACTER Raw live-action military footage. Photorealistic aircraft, crew and ocean. Natural overcast exposure. Weathered equipment. Atmospheric haze. Sensor noise and minor camera imperfections. No CGI appearance. No video-game aesthetic. No Hollywood treatment. No slow motion. No oversized explosions. No impossible camera movement. CONTINUITY Same fictional fighter, carrier, weather, deck and crew throughout. Aircraft direction and position remain geographically consistent. items.description: THE KITSUNE BLADE SEQUENCE — SEEDANCE 2.0 + GPT IMAGE 2 STORYBOARD One fox warrior. A minimal white studio backdrop. Every slash reads clean because nothing in the frame is fighting for attention. Most creators build a c
items.prompt: THE KITSUNE BLADE SEQUENCE — SEEDANCE 2.0 + GPT IMAGE 2 STORYBOARD One fox warrior. A minimal white studio backdrop. Every slash reads clean because nothing in the frame is fighting for attention. Most creators build a character like this and then generate the fight scene straight from a single hero image hoping Seedance guesses the choreography. It doesn't - you get a great character standing in a great pose cut after cut, never actually fighting. Here's the workflow 1. Build the character concept and lock it in GPT Image 2 first- golden fox ears, long amber hair, flowing gold-and-black robe, calm amber eyes hiding controlled aggression, proportions and fabric behavior fixed before motion enters the picture 2. Build a separate storyboard per scene instead of one giant grid -stillness gets its own board, the charge gets its own, the strike and the aftermath each get their own. More room per panel for camera notes, and one scene can be revised without touching the rest 3. Strip the environment down to a plain white/grey studio backdrop, and let the sword carry the energy instead - a single glowing gold trail following the blade does more for "power" than any explosion behind her would 4. Merge the boards into one sheet only at the end, purely for review and to fit the whole sequence into a single reference video - actual generation still pulls from each scene's board individually 5. Animate each scene from its own storyboard in Seedance 2.0 as a staging and camera-movement reference only, with likeness anchored to the GPT Image 2 sheet throughout Why this works - Splitting boards by scene means every camera setup gets enough space to actually be planned, not crammed into a tiny panel - The glowing blade trail becomes the character's signature -consistent across every cut because it's designed once, not improvised per shot - Each scene can be regenerated or refined on its own without disturbing the sequence around it - The calm extreme close-up after the burst is what sells "predator at rest" - stillness after violence hits harder than more violence would Made with GPT Image 2 (storyboard) + Seedance 2.0 (animation). Full reference sheet + prompt in the comments below↓

items.rawText: THE KITSUNE BLADE SEQUENCE — SEEDANCE 2.0 + GPT IMAGE 2 STORYBOARD One fox warrior. A minimal white studio backdrop. Every slash reads clean because nothing in the frame is fighting for attention. Most creators build a character like this and then generate the fight scene straight from a single hero image hoping Seedance guesses the choreography. It doesn't - you get a great character standing in a great pose cut after cut, never actually fighting. Here's the workflow 1. Build the character concept and lock it in GPT Image 2 first- golden fox ears, long amber hair, flowing gold-and-black robe, calm amber eyes hiding controlled aggression, proportions and fabric behavior fixed before motion enters the picture 2. Build a separate storyboard per scene instead of one giant grid -stillness gets its own board, the charge gets its own, the strike and the aftermath each get their own. More room per panel for camera notes, and one scene can be revised without touching the rest 3. Strip the environment down to a plain white/grey studio backdrop, and let the sword carry the energy instead - a single glowing gold trail following the blade does more for "power" than any explosion behind her would 4. Merge the boards into one sheet only at the end, purely for review and to fit the whole sequence into a single reference video - actual generation still pulls from each scene's board individually 5. Animate each scene from its own storyboard in Seedance 2.0 as a staging and camera-movement reference only, with likeness anchored to the GPT Image 2 sheet throughout Why this works - Splitting boards by scene means every camera setup gets enough space to actually be planned, not crammed into a tiny panel - The glowing blade trail becomes the character's signature -consistent across every cut because it's designed once, not improvised per shot - Each scene can be regenerated or refined on its own without disturbing the sequence around it - The calm extreme close-up after the burst is what sells "predator at rest" - stillness after violence hits harder than more violence would Made with GPT Image 2 (storyboard) + Seedance 2.0 (animation). Full reference sheet + prompt in the comments below↓

items.description: WHY MOST AI CHARACTERS BREAK BY SCENE 3 — SEEDANCE 2.0 + CHATGPT IMAGE 2 A creator renders the same character across three Seedance 2.0 scenes. Expects it to look like one story. Instead the jacket changes. The blade cha
items.prompt: WHY MOST AI CHARACTERS BREAK BY SCENE 3 — SEEDANCE 2.0 + CHATGPT IMAGE 2 A creator renders the same character across three Seedance 2.0 scenes. Expects it to look like one story. Instead the jacket changes. The blade changes color. The face drifts. By scene three, it’s not the same person anymore. The render didn’t break it. The prep did. Most multi-location clips fall apart because the character changes shape between scenes. Face close enough. Outfit close enough. Nothing actually matches once the clips sit side by side. The people getting clean results aren’t prompting harder per scene. They lock the character once in ChatGPT Image 2. Then build a separate location atlas for every environment — before a single clip gets generated. Character design sheet comes first. Full turnaround, expressions, silhouette study, detail crops. Built once. Reused across every scene. Never regenerated per location. Each location gets its own atlas: Wide establishing shot Camera path diagram Lighting study Material swatches Environment-specific details (dust behavior, ember flow) Camera path gets planned before generation, not guessed inside the Seedance prompt. An orbit diagram or push-in path drawn in advance keeps motion intentional instead of improvised. Lighting stays location-specific, character stays consistent. A red blade reads differently in desert daylight, golden-hour field, and volcanic interior. The character’s silhouette and proportions never shift. Where this breaks: Skipping the design sheet and regenerating the character fresh per location. Small drifts stack fast — hair length, jacket detail, blade color — and by scene three it’s obviously not the same person. The other failure: one long Seedance prompt for the whole scene instead of anchoring each location with its own reference frame first. Seedance only extends what the frame gives it. No locked character, no planned path — motion has nothing stable to build on. The gap between a clean multi-location clip and a broken one isn’t the render. It’s everything decided before the render starts. Full guide — zero to finished cinematic video — below 🔖

items.description: THE SHOT THAT MAKES A LOCKED CHARACTER FEEL LIKE A REAL PERSON The character sheet was already perfect. The video is what proves it. Most creators lock a character sheet in GPT Image 2 and think the job is done. The real
items.prompt: THE SHOT THAT MAKES A LOCKED CHARACTER FEEL LIKE A REAL PERSON The character sheet was already perfect. The video is what proves it. Most creators lock a character sheet in GPT Image 2 and think the job is done. The real test only happens once that character has to move hold a blade and turn toward camera without a single detail slipping. Here's the workflow 1. Build the character concept -a cyber-oni android warrior, pale porcelain skin silver-white hair, twin ivory horns one robotic arm with crimson claw-tips katana in black-and-red wrap 2. Lock the full reference sheet in GPT Image 2 - front/side/back turnaround, detail callouts on face, neck mechanism, blade, and claws, plus a color palette 3. Draft a shot-by-shot sequence - silhouette open → slow orbit reveal → blade motion → extreme close-up on the eyes → wide hero stand on reflective ground 4. Repeat the identity-lock line in every single shot prompt- face, horns, coat emblem, and robotic arm called out by name, not left to the reference image alone 5. Keep the environment palette consistent - deep red sky, black smoke, reflective black ground - so lighting never resets between cuts 6. Let the close-up shots do the identity-proofing -eyes and face detail are where drift shows first so give them dedicated frames 7. Animate the full sequence in Seedance 2.0 straight from the locked sheet + shot list Why this works: • The robotic arm and horn shape stay identical from the wide shot to the extreme close-up • Red accent lighting carries through every cut instead of shifting tone • The blade's wrap pattern and tsuba stay recognizable even in fast motion • Eyes hold the same iris detail in close-up as they did in the reference sheet • Way fewer regenerations per shot Use cases: ⁃ Character showcase reels ⁃ Game trailer teasers ⁃ Original IP / OC promotional content ⁃ Dark fantasy and cyberpunk short films ⁃ Style-driven AI video demos The character sheet answers who she is. This is what proves she's real.

items.prompt: Seedance 2.0 Memory realism adventure featuring a visit to Grandmother's house created using Seedance 2.0 Prompt: Main Subject Young Chinese woman, early 20s. Natural appearance. Black hair loosely tied back with soft bangs and a few loose strands moving in the breeze. Minimal makeup. Faded cream sleeveless top. Loose light-blue jeans. Worn canvas sneakers. Consistent identity throughout. Location Authentic rural Chinese village on a warm summer afternoon. Whitewashed walls. Grey tiled roofs. Vegetable garden. Stone pathways. Bamboo baskets. Clay pots. Citrus trees. Laundry hanging outside. Wooden courtyard gate. Quiet countryside atmosphere. No commercial elements. Visual Style Ultra-realistic memory-like documentary footage. Feels like a family member casually recording moments during a visit. Sharp facial detail. Natural skin texture. Realistic lighting. Authentic environmental motion. High-quality image. No cinematic color grading. No exaggerated vintage effects. No obvious AI look. The footage should feel genuinely recorded rather than generated. Camera Treatment Consumer digital camera from approximately 2008–2012. Handheld but mostly stable. Natural human movement while filming. Occasional framing imperfections. Minor focus breathing. Subtle exposure adaptation when moving between sunlight and shade. No excessive shake. No heavy blur. No strong digital noise. No aggressive autofocus hunting. The camera supports the memory rather than drawing attention to itself. 00:00–00:02 The camera follows her entering through a wooden courtyard gate. She notices her grandmother watering vegetables and immediately smiles. The camera lingers naturally as she walks toward her. 00:02–00:04 Grandmother is watering a small vegetable patch. The young woman gently takes the watering can and helps. Both laugh naturally. A light breeze moves nearby plants. 00:04–00:06 Grandmother points toward something growing among the vegetables. The young woman crouches beside her to look. Sunlight filters through leaves overhead. Small authentic gestures and eye contact. 00:06–00:08 In the courtyard. Grandmother hands her a fresh orange segment. She tastes it and smiles. The camera quietly observes the moment without interruption. 00:08–00:10 They fold laundry together beside a clothesline. Fabric moves gently in the summer breeze. Conversation continues naturally. No posing. 00:10–00:12 Sitting together on small stools beneath shade. Grandmother says something amusing. The young woman laughs and leans slightly toward her. The moment feels completely unplanned. 00:12–00:15 Leaving through the courtyard gate carrying a small bag of fruit. Halfway down the path she turns around. Her grandmother is still standing there watching. They exchange one final wave. The camera remains still for a moment after she turns away. Recording ends naturally. Audio Birds. Distant village ambience. Wind through trees. Laundry fluttering. Footsteps on stone. Quiet conversation. Occasional chicken sounds. No music. No narration. No sound design. Generation Goal A real family memory unexpectedly preserved on a camera. Warm. Ordinary. Deeply human. The viewer should feel like they are watching somebody's genuine childhood memory.

items.prompt: Seedance 2.0 on Vidfield AI Prompt: Create a 15-second realistic cinematic slice-of-life video in 16:9, 24fps. Visual-only video, no dialogue, no voice, no music, no sound effects, no subtitles, no text on screen. Warm golden-hour sunlight, soft handheld camera, muted film color grade, slight grain, natural shadows, peaceful nostalgic mood. Fully realistic live-action style, not game-like, not animated. Main character: a young Japanese woman in her early 20s with soft natural features, dark hair tied in a loose low bun with a small traditional hairpin. She wears elegant traditional Japanese attire: a simple cream-and-muted-blue yukata/kimono-style outfit with a subtle floral pattern, tied with a soft obi belt, light tabi-style sandals. Keep her calm, gentle, warm expression consistent in every shot. Location: a long narrow real-life residential alley with a Japanese touch. Tall tan stone and concrete walls, sandy dusty ground, warm sunlight glowing on one side, soft tree shadows across the path, palm trees and green leaves above the walls, small Japanese details like a wooden gate, paper lantern near a doorway, simple noren curtain, potted bonsai-style plants, and a blue painted wall far ahead. One bicycle leans near the end of the alley. Quiet empty neighborhood feeling. 0:00–0:02: Rear tracking shot. The Japanese woman walks slowly through the narrow alley from behind. Her yukata fabric moves gently as she walks. Golden sunlight stretches across the tan walls. Camera follows with natural handheld motion. 0:02–0:04: Wide alley shot. A small gray-brown tabby cat appears from a low gap near the left side wall and steps into the alley. The woman notices it, slows down, and turns slightly toward it. 0:04–0:06: Medium side shot. The cat walks near her feet and looks up. She smiles softly, bends down slowly, and extends one hand in a gentle careful way. 0:06–0:08: Low close-up. The cat sniffs her fingers, then rubs its head against her hand. She gently pets the cat’s head and back. Show realistic fur texture, tiny whisker movement, and natural cat behavior. 0:08–0:10: Emotional close-up. The woman smiles warmly while petting the cat. Sunlight flickers through tree leaves across her face, hairpin, shoulders, and kimono fabric. 0:10–0:12: Medium-wide shot. The cat walks ahead a few steps, then looks back at her. She stands slowly and follows it with a peaceful curious smile. The Japanese alley details remain subtle and realistic. 0:12–0:14: Front tracking shot. She walks toward camera with the cat beside her near the wall. She looks down at the cat and smiles. The long alley, tan walls, Japanese details, blue wall, bicycle, and trees remain visible in the background. 0:14–0:15: Final close shot. The cat brushes against her leg. She looks toward the camera with a soft peaceful smile, then looks down at the cat again. Hold the warm golden Japanese alley atmosphere for a gentle cinematic ending.

Seedance 2.0 4K Prompt: Maintain a consistent environment, vehicles, police uniforms, and motorcycle throughout the video. The setting is a modern city highway bridge during daylight. The chase is fast, cinematic, and high tension. Maintain seamless continuity between all scenes with smooth camera transitions. Style: Cinematic action thriller, realistic vehicle physics, dynamic camera movement, premium movie quality, dramatic lighting, high-speed motion, realistic traffic, aerial cinematography, shallow depth of field, 8K cinematic rendering. Audio: Intense cinematic chase score, continuous police sirens, motorcycle engine revving, tire noise, wind, passing traffic. No dialogue. Scene 1 (0–2s) A wide aerial view looks down at a long highway bridge filled with moving traffic. A convoy of police cars with flashing red and blue lights races across the bridge with sirens blaring as they pursue a single motorcycle weaving through traffic. Camera: High-altitude drone shot slowly descending toward the chase. Scene 2 (2–4s) The camera dives closer to the bridge before cutting to a helmet-mounted perspective from the motorcyclist. The rider rapidly approaches slower traffic while police vehicles remain visible in the mirrors with flashing lights. Camera: First-person helmet camera with realistic speed and motion. Scene 3 (4–6.5s) The view transitions to a cinematic tracking shot beside the motorcycle. The rider expertly leans through traffic, squeezing between cars and overtaking vehicles at high speed while maintaining control. Camera: Smooth side tracking shot followed by a low front angle. Patrol cars brake, change lanes, and struggle to keep up because they cannot fit through the narrow gaps that the motorcycle easily passes. Camera: Alternating shots from behind the police cars, overhead drone views, and low roadside tracking shots. Scene 5 (9–12s) The motorcycle accelerates even faster, weaving through the final stretch of traffic. The distance between the rider and the police grows rapidly as the bridge opens ahead. Camera: Dynamic orbit around the motorcycle, then a tracking shot from in front as the rider speeds toward the end of the bridge. Scene 6 (12–15s) A wide cinematic aerial shot shows the motorcycle racing toward the distant horizon at the far end of the bridge while the police convoy falls farther behind. The flashing lights become smaller as the rider disappears into the distance, leaving the pursuit behind. Camera: Slow pullback aerial shot ending with the motorcycle fading toward the horizon. items.prompt: 📖YOU COULD BE USING SEEDANCE 2.0 WRONGLY AND HERE'S WHY Three models were tested: GPT, Gemini and Claude and the difference is greater than expected Three models. One task. Write a cinematic prompt for AI video. Here's what each one does differently: • ChatGPT 5.4 — The Strategist GPT-5.4 approaches a prompt like an analyst. It breaks everything down into structured blocks: subject → action → environment → lighting → mood → camera movement. The result is clean, logical, and technically precise. The downside? It can feel a little cold. There's control and predictability, but sometimes less creative fire. Best when you want exact, repeatable results. - Strength: structure, accuracy, fewer hallucinations Weakness: less emotional charge, reads more like a brief than a vision • Gemini 3.5 — The Director Gemini 3.5 thinks like someone standing on a film set. It factors in scene context, motion physics, and atmosphere — prompts come out with details like "ice shards catching the light as the blade cuts through" or "hair trailing in slow motion against a frozen horizon." The native multimodality makes it naturally think in visuals before the video even exists. The result feels alive and cinematic. - Strength: cinematic thinking, physical detail, atmosphere Weakness: prompts can run long and overly descriptive • Claude Opus 4.7 — The Storyteller Opus 4.7 writes a prompt the way a novelist would. It builds in emotion, inner state, and narrative — and that shows up in the output. Where GPT gives technical precision and Gemini gives cinematic imagery, Claude gives feeling. Prompts are often shorter but denser in meaning. Videos generated from them tend to carry a more human quality. - Strength: emotional depth, narrative, style Weakness: fewer hard technical specs for complex scenes Bottom line: Need precision → GPT 5.4 Need cinematic quality → Gemini 3.5 Need soul → Claude Opus 4.7 How do you write prompts? What do you use? 📥Tomorrow I will make another comparison, but for now I will not reveal the secret which 🔖Below is a guide to using Dreamina for beginners

items.prompt: Meta just launched its 1st image model after Mark Zuckerberg’s AI shake-up. Muse Image is Meta Superintelligence Labs' first image generator after Muse Spark. They said the model will power new editing features in Meta’s Instagram photo app and be added to its marketer tools for creating platform ads. Meta had relied on Midjourney and Black Forest Labs for generation inside Meta AI. Muse Image brings that layer in-house, so Meta controls quality, cost, and product timing. Consumers get free access through Meta AI, WhatsApp chats, and Instagram Stories. Power users need Meta One or another monthly plan when free limits run out. Users can start from prompts, add photos, annotate edits, or sketch changes directly. Meta says it can erase photobombers, create QR codes, and keep visual text readable. Advertisers get variants through Advantage+ creative, with edits, style swaps, and brand-matched versions. Meta says internal tests trail GPT Image 2 but beat Nano Banana 2 on editing. This is another move in Meta's effort in trying to convert AI infrastructure spending into revenue beyond social ads.

items.prompt: I love this tracking shot style. Tracking the creature into destined character. I am using Seedance 2.0 on @dreamina_ai with only 1 image and 1 prompt ⬇️ PROMPT: Single continuous uninterrupted cinematic shot, no cuts, one flowing 15-second take. Desaturated cool palette with warm amber accents, deep shadow falloff, fine 35mm grain. Photorealistic live-action film, NOT animated, NOT a video game, NOT CGI render. A tense body-horror transformation at an archaeological expedition dig site in a vast sun-scorched desert at harsh midday, heat shimmer, drifting sand and dust. The shot opens at extreme ground level on a SMALL black desert scorpion — only palm-sized, realistic natural scale — ALREADY sprinting at full speed across the sand from the very first frame, mid-run, never stationary, the camera tracking low and fast right beside it. It races across open ground, weaving past scattered expedition gear — brushes, trowels, open crates, ropes, dusty boots of crew members — a long fast ground-level chase. Still in the same unbroken shot, the small scorpion reaches a man crouched at the dig — the man [IMAGE REFERENCE], in a dusty khaki expedition field shirt with rolled sleeves, utility vest, cargo pants and glasses. He holds a small ancient artifact up in both hands close to his face, calm and completely unaware, carefully examining and inspecting its fine details, turning it slowly to study the carvings, fully absorbed and fascinated by the small relic. The scorpion suddenly leaps onto the back of his hand. ONLY at the moment it lands does he react — he flinches hard, startled. The camera stays locked on the scorpion, following it closely as it scurries fast up his forearm, over his shoulder, onto his neck, and jabs its stinger hard into his neck. Only now does the camera ease back slightly to a medium shot: he cries out, slaps the scorpion off and flings it away, stumbling to his feet, gripping his neck in pain and confusion. Glowing sickly yellow-green venom veins spread from the sting across his neck and face as he convulses, his body warping and hardening into a monstrous humanoid scorpion creature — glossy dark chitinous exoskeleton with segmented armored plates, serrated pincers forming from his hands, glowing venomous yellow-green eyes, a massive segmented scorpion tail with a dripping stinger arching over his back. The shot stays close for the finale — a raw handheld medium shot, the camera shaking and reactive like real documentary footage, staying tight on the creature as it screeches and rampages through the dig site, thrashing its pincers and tail, knocking over crates and equipment, while terrified crew members in matching khaki outfits sprint past the camera in panic, dust kicking up, the handheld camera jostling among the chaos, gritty and real. No aerial view, no wide shot — stay in the chaos at ground level until the end. No music. #DreaminaCPP

items.prompt: MOST PEOPLE ARE PROMPTING SEEDANCE 2.0 LIKE IT’S A SEARCH BAR AND IT’S COSTING THEM One simple structural change fixes most of the inconsistency. You know the cycle: write a sentence, hit generate, hate it, rewrite the whole thing from scratch. Most of us have been stuck there. The creators getting consistent results ditched that approach months ago. They treat prompts more like a production brief — every piece handled separately instead of crammed into one wall of text. Break it down like this: • Character identity • Environment + visual style • Camera behavior • Action sequence + pacing • Transitions That’s honestly it. Why it works so well: • Your character actually stays consistent across shots • Camera moves feel intentional instead of drunk • You can tweak one thing without breaking everything else • It turns into a reusable template for the whole series Simple workflow: 1. Decide what the video actually needs to say 2. Nail the character description once, in detail 3. Define environment/style as its own block 4. Write action and camera separately 5. Combine them cleanly Example: Character — hooded dragon knight Environment — misty ash-covered ruins Action — crouching, reaching for the eggs Camera — slow handheld push-in Style — cinematic, desaturated, 24fps Once you have this, the next scene isn’t a full rewrite. You just change one field. We’re moving from “prompting” to “designing a system.” The future of AI video isn’t a better sentence — it’s a structure you reuse instead of rebuild every time. items.prompt: AI video generation gets much easier when you stop treating audio as an afterthought. A workflow I’ve been exploring: 1. Create the complete soundtrack with Seed-Audio 1.0. 2. Use that audio to drive the visuals in Seedance. Instead of one giant prompt describing dialogue, music, sound effects, emotions, and camera movement, each model focuses on what it does best. The result is a more natural production process: • Dialogue defines the rhythm. • Music shapes the emotional arc. • Sound effects reinforce every action. • Ambient audio gives the scene depth. Once that’s locked in, Seedance can concentrate on cinematic visuals and camera motion. It’s a simple shift in workflow, but for AI films, story-driven content, and game cinematics, it can make the entire generation process feel far more intentional. Think audio first. Visuals second. Preserve the exact facial features, hairstyle, body proportions, skin tone, and identity throughout the entire video. The character must remain perfectly consistent. Do NOT change the face, body, or hairstyle. Only the outfit and environment change. Create a premium 15-second cinematic travel-fashion commercial where the character journeys through seven iconic countries. Every transition is triggered by the character touching or adjusting her outfit. As the outfit transforms, the entire environment seamlessly changes into the next country. The camera follows the character in one continuous cinematic shot with smooth movement and no cuts. Sequence: ① France 🇫🇷 The character wears an elegant Parisian luxury outfit. She gently adjusts her blazer collar. As she pulls the collar into place, her outfit transforms into the next country's traditional fashion while the Eiffel Tower and the streets of Paris seamlessly become the next location. ② Japan 🇯🇵 She now wears a modern luxury kimono-inspired outfit. As her hand moves downward, the outfit transforms while the palace becomes the streets of Italy. Background: Colosseum and Rome cityscape. ④ Italy 🇮🇹 She wears elegant Italian luxury fashion. She adjusts her sunglasses and smiles confidently. As she lowers her hand, both the outfit and scenery transform. Background: Colosseum and classic Roman architecture. ⑤ United Arab Emirates 🇦🇪 She now wears a luxurious modern abaya-inspired couture outfit. She gently lifts the flowing fabric. As it falls, the environment transforms. Background: Burj Khalifa and Downtown Dubai at sunset. ⑥ India 🇮🇳 She wears an elegant contemporary designer saree. She gracefully adjusts the pallu over her shoulder. During the motion, the outfit transforms once more. Background: Taj Mahal during golden hour. ⑦ United States 🇺🇸 (Final Hero Scene) She now wears premium New York luxury street fashion. She confidently walks toward the camera as Times Square and the New York skyline surround her. The camera slowly pushes in while she gives a confident smile, ending with a premium fashion-commercial hero shot. Every transition is physically motivated by touching, adjusting, pulling, or spinning the clothing. The outfit and environment transform simultaneously with seamless cinematic match cuts, realistic fabric simulation, and premium architectural morphing. Camera: One continuous tracking shot, smooth dolly movement, occasional orbit, 50mm and 85mm cinematic lenses, shallow depth of field. Lighting: Natural golden-hour lighting adapted to each country with realistic reflections, soft rim lighting, and cinematic atmosphere. Style: Luxury Louis Vuitton, Dior, Gucci, Chanel global fashion campaign mixed with National Geographic travel cinematography. items.prompt: ONE SPIN AND SHE'S A DIFFERENT PERSON. Seedance 2.0 Prompt: Scene & Mood: Sharp studio editorial built around a single continuous spin transformation. A woman in a fitted matte-black slip dress stands center frame under moody spotlighting, still and composed, then spins once and completes the rotation in a completely different look: a structured chrome art-deco gown with metallic panel detailing. The mood is theatrical, high-impact, confident, with the spin treated as one unbroken magic trick rather than a cut. Frame Map: Begin in a medium-full frontal composition, subject centered, arms relaxed at her sides, dark studio backdrop with a single hard key light from camera-left casting a long diagonal shadow. Maintain headroom above and enough negative space on both sides to track the dress silhouette expanding mid-spin. The floor is glossy black, reflecting a faint silhouette. Subject Lock: Keep the same face, hair part, height, and body proportions throughout both looks. Look A: sleek middle-parted dark hair, matte-black slip dress, bare shoulders, minimal silver jewelry, neutral confident expression. Look B (post-spin): same hair now swept into a sharp low chignon, structured chrome-panel gown with a stiff architectural collar, metallic cuff on one wrist, same facial features and expression carried through. Do not change her height, face shape, or skin tone between looks. Cross-Frame Rules: She is the only person and subject in frame at all times. The transformation must occur entirely within the single continuous spin motion — no jump cuts, no freeze frames, no duplicated bodies mid-spin. Fabric physics must look weighty and real during the whirl, not liquid or melting. No on-screen text, no captions, no signage typography, no rendered text in the frame. Movement: 6 seconds total. She begins still for 1 second, then initiates a fast single clockwise spin over 2 seconds, dress and hair flaring outward with real centrifugal motion, arms lifting slightly for balance. As she completes the rotation and faces camera again, the new gown settles into place with a final fabric snap and hair falls into its chignon shape naturally. She holds the new pose, still and composed, for the final 3 seconds, chin lifted, eyes locked on camera. Last Frame: She stands still in the chrome art-deco gown, facing camera directly, chin slightly lifted, one hand resting at her hip, expression calm and powerful. Studio light holds steady on her face. No on-screen text, no captions, no signage typography, no rendered text in the frame. World Plate: Minimal black-box studio, single hard key light, glossy reflective floor, deep shadow falloff into the background with no visible walls or props. Clean, high-contrast, editorial darkness. Sound Bed: Diegetic audio only: fabric whoosh during the spin, a soft heel pivot on the glossy floor, faint jewelry chime, quiet room tone. No music, no soundtrack, no score, no lyrics. Capture Realism: Natural skin texture, real fabric weight and flare physics, believable hair movement settling into the chignon, grounded contact shadows, soft highlight rolloff, fine 35mm grain. Avoid AI gloss, warped limbs, melted fabric, duplicated body parts, or hair clipping through the gown collar. Camera Capture: 6 seconds, 24fps, locked-off static camera, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field isolating subject from the dark backdrop, punchy contrast grade, fine grain, crisp studio realism.

items.prompt: THIS GUY CONNECTED FABLE 5 + HIGGSFIELD SO ONE CLAUDE PROMPT CAN BECOME 5 DIFFERENT CREATIVE ASSETS The interesting part is not “Claude can make a video.” It is the stack shape. Claude becomes the front door. Fable 5 handles the creative brief/control layer. Higgsfield gives the workflow access to image and video generation. Then one prompt can branch into different outputs instead of dying as one static answer. The video shows the simple version: Open Claude. Add a custom connector. Paste the Higgsfield MCP connector back in. Use Claude to drive the creative stack. The demos are the scroll-stopper: realistic UGC-style ad creatives animated websites 3D models turned into cinematic scenes years of research turned into an interactive game world scripts turned into explainer videos with generated visuals That is the specific payoff. A solo marketer can test 5 ad directions before hiring a production team. A founder can turn a landing page idea into motion assets in the same session. A creator can move from script to visual treatment without manually opening 6 different tools. The reusable mechanism is simple: the brief, the routing, and the asset generation start happening inside one conversation. That changes who can prototype. Not because every output is production-ready. Because the first version gets cheaper, faster, and more visual. Caveat is obvious: this is still a connector workflow, not magic production quality. You still need taste, prompting, iteration, rights checks, and a human deciding what is usable. But Fable 5 + Higgsfield is one of the clearest examples of where Claude is going: less chatbot, more creative software control room.

items.prompt: Seedance 2.0 Prompt 👇 Scene & Mood: Cinematic luxury portrait in a warm amber Arabian lounge. Calm, powerful, mysterious mood. Rich red textiles, brass lanterns, patterned cushions, soft haze, and practical firelight. Frame Map: Start from image1composition. Subject stays center right in a medium wide seated portrait, facing camera. Knees and hands remain visible. Ornate tea table and brass objects stay softly blurred in the lower foreground. Lanterns, cushions, and carved wall decor remain behind him. Keep warm negative space on the left. Slow push in ends as a closer medium portrait. Subject Lock: Image1 Preserve the same seated male subject: same face, skin tone, trimmed facial hair, dark sunglasses, red and white keffiyeh, black agal, white thobe, leopard pattern cloak, watch, rings, body shape, seated posture, relaxed hand placement, and composed expression. Image 1 the same face, hair, wardrobe, body shape, and silhouette throughout. Cloak stays naturally draped over both shoulders. Thobe stays matte white with soft real fabric folds. Cross Frame Rules: No identity drift, no face change, no wardrobe change, no altered sunglasses, no extra jewelry, no headwear change. Subject remains center right at the same depth and eyeline. Do not add people or modern objects. Keep the same lounge layout, lantern positions, patterned textiles, brass objects, amber palette, and shallow depth. Movement: 15s continuous shot. Subject remains seated and still with slow breathing. His right fingers relax slightly on his knee, left hand barely shifts against the fabric, and his head tilts a few degrees toward camera. Keffiyeh edge, cloak fibers, thobe folds, watch, and rings catch tiny natural movements. Lantern flames flicker gently, brass highlights shimmer softly, haze drifts in the background. Camera makes a slow, smooth push in with subtle handheld breath, never shaky. Last Frame: End on a closer medium portrait. Subject remains center-right, sunglasses facing camera, shoulders and upper torso dominant, right hand relaxed on knee, leopard cloak framing the white thobe. Lantern glow and patterned textiles stay softly visible behind him. Camera settles nearly locked. No on screen text, no captions, no signage typography, no rendered text in the frame. World Plate: Ornate lounge with burgundy, red, black, gold, and amber tones. Layered rugs, cushions, wall hangings, carved circular wall decor, brass lanterns, and polished metal objects create depth. Lighting comes from practical lanterns with soft falloff and lifted shadows. Mild incense haze adds air depth. Textures feel tactile: woven fabric, matte cotton, aged brass, carved metal, natural looking fur. Sound Bed: Diegetic audio only: quiet lantern flame flicker, faint room tone, soft fabric rustle from breathing, subtle jewelry movement, distant air movement. No music, no score, no vocals, no lyrics. Capture Realism: Natural skin texture, matte skin, realistic facial hair, believable fabric weight, soft highlight rolloff, lifted shadows, mild grain, restrained contrast, no plastic AI gloss, no doll skin, no over sharpening, no crushed blacks, no clipped whites. Brass glows softly, not mirror shiny. Fur texture stays natural. Camera Capture: 50mm cinema lens, slow push in portrait shot, 24fps, 180 degree shutter, wide latitude cinema capture, subtle handheld breath, shallow depth of field, fine 35mm film grain, warm amber burgundy grade, realistic practical lantern light, 15s runtime.

items.prompt: 2.8 million views. Without a single real ingredient. No stove. No camera. No chef. While most people spend hours filming, buying ingredients, and chasing perfect lighting, someone else is already getting millions of views from content that never existed in the real world. And if you ignore this trend today, in just a few years you may find yourself watching others profit from the new attention economy while you’re trying to catch up. The secret lies in disciplined prompt engineering. You don’t ask AI to simply “make a video.” You first generate a photorealistic reference image of the dish, then break it into 10 separate scenes with precisely defined camera angles, motion blur, depth of field, rising steam, and the tiny visual details that convince viewers they’re watching a real kitchen. Each scene is turned into a two-second clip using Image-to-Video generators, then everything is assembled in CapCut with trending music and automatic captions. Those captions - combined with the right editing pace - are crucial for audience retention because today’s viewers want to watch food that looks irresistible, whether it exists in the real world or not. Instead of being limited by filming, expensive equipment, or lighting, you become the architect of a content factory that can scale almost infinitely - from earning through Creator Rewards to selling AI-generated food content to restaurants that want flawless videos without renting a studio or hiring professional chefs. This isn’t the future anymore - it’s the new attention economy. And in this economy, your greatest asset isn’t culinary talent. It’s your ability to write prompts that make the TikTok, Facebook, and YouTube algorithms work for you. While others are cooking meals, you can build a scalable system, hit “Export,” and collect views that turn into real income.

items.prompt: 🚨GUESS WHICH VIDEO WAS SHOT ON A REAL CAMERA AND WHICH ONE WAS MADE IN SEEDANCE To make AI video look real, it’s not enough to just write “realistic”. You have to deliberately add the things that usually ruin a shot: > Shaky handheld camera > Slight digital artifacts > Small focus misses These “imperfections” are exactly what makes it feel alive. items.prompt: I remember having a very similar style on Midjourney back in the day. A long time ago actually. Now you can do it with GPT Prompt: 2x2 grid, 16:9, do this for 4 days that made humans hope: input = $ subject # 1. analyze the subject. silhouette = extract_silhouette(input) internal_rhythm = detect_repeated_details(input) gesture_flow = infer_motion_paths(input) focal_zones = detect_focal_regions(input) # 2. convert the subject into an optical terrain. subject_field = morph_into_op_art( silhouette, surface_logic=[ 'wavy contour bands', 'parallel black-white ribbons', 'nested curves', 'glowing grayscale gradients', 'liquid negative space' ], preserve_identity=true ) # 3. replace texture with hypnotic pattern behavior. pattern_layer = generate_patterns( source=internal_rhythm, pattern_types=[ 'concentric rings', 'spiral curls', 'bubble chains', 'dot constellations', 'striped topographic lines', 'ornamental lace paths' ], contrast='pure black to bright white', density='medium-high' ) # 4. turn the environment into a dream metropolis / symbolic field. background = construct_surreal_stage( based_on=input, elements=[ 'impossible towers', 'floating moons', 'arched city silhouettes', 'long luminous roadways', 'wave-like ground planes', 'star-speckled black sky' ], style='monochrome dream architecture' ) # 5. add grayscale glow, not color. lighting = apply_luminous_monochrome( highlights='soft white glow along edges', shadows='deep velvet black', midtones='smooth metallic gray gradients' ) output: a black-and-white surreal op-art transformation of $ subject, where form, ground, and background become flowing optical waves, glowing city geometry, ornamental pattern density, and hypnotic grayscale depth. avoid: - color - flat simple vector only - messy sketch lines - realistic material texture - cartoon cuteness - photographic depth of field

items.description: 📖SEEDANCE 2.5 VS 2.0: THE FIRST AI VIDEO MODEL THAT DOESN'T FORCE YOU TO STITCH CLIPS TOGETHER. ByteDance skipped straight from 2.0 to 2.5 — no small update, a generational jump. Seedance 2.0 caps out at 15 seconds per
items.prompt: 📖SEEDANCE 2.5 VS 2.0: THE FIRST AI VIDEO MODEL THAT DOESN'T FORCE YOU TO STITCH CLIPS TOGETHER. ByteDance skipped straight from 2.0 to 2.5 — no small update, a generational jump. Seedance 2.0 caps out at 15 seconds per clip. Anything longer means generating multiple pieces and stitching them on a timeline, hoping the face, lighting, and motion hold up across the cut. Seedance 2.5 generates 30 seconds in a single continuous pass. No stitching. No seams. One character tracked across an entire scene, start to finish. Here's what actually changed: • Native 30-second clips in one generation, up from 15 seconds • Up to 50 multimodal reference inputs (images, video, audio), up from just 12 • Localized editing — change one element (an outfit, a prop, a background) without regenerating the whole clip • 3D white-model previz — block out camera angles and composition before the final render • Native 4K with 10-bit color and synced audio in the same pass The catch: 2.5 is still rolling out in stages, with full public access expected in early July. Seedance 2.0 already renders native 4K today and remains the faster, cheaper option for short social clips. 📥Tomorrow I am covering a topic that most people skip and then regret skipping. 🔖Every step of this workflow is documented in the pinned article below. ABSOLUTELY NO MUSIC. Wearing the identical luxurious white tailored suit with the jacket open, exposing the chest tattoos, white tailored trousers, black belt with a large gold “M” buckle, gold waist chain, white sneakers, dark sunglasses, wristwatch, and the identical dramatic long black feather coat draped over his shoulders. Hair tied into the identical man bun throughout the sequence. Calm, fearless, emotionless, highly trained elite assassin. LOCATION A breathtaking Gothic European grand ballroom inside an ancient luxury palace. Towering black marble columns. Massive crystal chandeliers. Gothic vaulted ceiling. Pointed arches. Black-and-gold baroque architecture. Tall stained-glass windows. Polished black-and-white marble floor reflecting warm chandelier light. Thin atmospheric haze. Completely empty. No furniture. No tables. No chairs. No guests. Only the man and three elite villains. His feather coat and open white suit move naturally through the air before he rotates smoothly and lands in a powerful three-point landing. Marble dust and tiny crystal fragments burst across the polished floor. 2.8–3.8s Three elite villains slowly emerge from different directions, silently surrounding him in a loose triangle formation. They immediately rush forward together. 3.8–6.2s The fight erupts instantly. He slips between the first two attackers with explosive footwork, smashing a brutal elbow into the first villain’s jaw before driving a crushing knee into the second villain’s ribs. The handheld camera violently whip-pans between impacts, repeatedly blocked by moving bodies before recovering the action. Light blood sprays from a split lip. No gore. #actionmovie #fight

items.prompt: I used to do a lot of these mini city prompts. Here is a new structure I have been trying lately. Animated with Kling. Prompt: I(0) = empty palm of hand, no sphere. I(1) = full detailed micro‑globe. ∂I/∂t = Δ(I, $ CITY) guided by: - Sphere appearing in palm. - Skyline crust growing radially as tiny plastic blocks. - Artery wrapping and curving. - Life details popping in. - Lighting evolving to daylight, DOF engaging. Integration: t=0.0–0.2: Hand appears, empty sphere materializes as a smooth grey ball. t=0.2–0.5: Building blocks erupt from surface, filling all space, height map guided by $ CITY. t=0.5–0.7: Artery curves around the front, dividing the dense crust. t=0.7–0.9: Tiny cars, boats, trees appear; material shifts to architectural model (plastic/wood). t=0.9–1.0: Daylight and DOF finalize, foreground hand sharp, background bokeh. Output I(1): photorealistic 1:1 macro image, ultra‑detailed, no empty space.

items.prompt: Sunday. Still some hours left for this Prompt Drop Weekend. Join the prompt drop party, share, try, create. ******* The Crane - Seedance 2.0 @Hailuo_AI Hyper-realistic cinematic action sequence, 15 seconds, aspect ratio 16:9. Night. High above a neon city, one female agent escapes across the upper levels of an unfinished skyscraper during a storm. She runs across wet steel beams and exposed concrete toward the outer edge of the construction site while security chases behind her. A giant crane towers overhead, its heavy hook and cable swinging violently in the wind between this tower and a second unfinished skyscraper nearby. Rain lashes the structure, warning lights blink red, and the city glows far below through mist. Wide opening shot: the female agent sprints across the unfinished floor of the skyscraper while security appears behind her, closing in through the steel framework. The crane hook swings overhead in the storm. Tracking shot: she runs across a narrow beam and leaps onto a small platform near the edge of the building. Wind whips her hair and clothing. The crane cable swings closer, and she times her move while the storm grows more violent. Side shot: the agent grabs the swinging crane hook or cable and is pulled out into open air between the two skyscrapers. She swings across the gap high above the city while rain, wind, and flashing warning lights intensify the danger. Security reaches the edge behind her but cannot follow. Final 5 seconds: the action becomes more intense. The swing carries her toward the second unfinished tower. She crashes feet-first into the outer framework, struggles for a split second to hold on, then pulls herself onto a narrow beam or platform. The crane hook swings away behind her as she regains balance and keeps moving forward. Final moment: the female agent lands on the second skyscraper structure and turns briefly as the crane continues swinging behind her in the storm, with the neon skyline far below. Style: hyper-realistic, cinematic, fast-paced, intense, stressful, clear readable action, strong sense of height, storm, rain, steel beams, swinging crane hook, dynamic but readable camera movement, no text, no logos, no cartoon style, no famous celebrity faces, no recognizable actors, no movie-star resemblance, no public-figure likenesses, no clear facial close-ups. Daytime during a violent storm. Two agents, one man and one woman, run along the top of a massive concrete dam while a security team chases behind them. The dam is huge and exposed, with narrow maintenance walkways, steel railings, warning lights, control boxes, heavy spray, and roaring water far below. Dark clouds gather overhead, wind drives rain across the structure, and the entire dam feels unstable under growing pressure. Wide opening shot: the two agents sprint along the top of the dam at full speed while security appears behind them, closing in. Water crashes below on one side, and storm wind pushes mist and spray across the walkway. Tracking shot: the agents keep running along the narrow concrete path as warning alarms flash. Ahead, massive spillway gates begin opening one by one. The structure shudders under the force, water erupts downward in huge torrents, and the agents struggle to keep balance on the slick surface. Side shot: the pressure increases. The dam shakes harder as more gates open. Spray blasts across the walkway, metal railings rattle, and one section of the path cracks near the edge. The agents keep moving, ducking around control structures and staying ahead of the security team. Final 5 seconds: the action becomes extreme. A maintenance section ahead partially breaks and drops, creating a gap in the walkway. The agents accelerate into a final desperate sprint, leap across the broken section, land hard, and keep moving while the spillway fully opens beside them. Water explodes downward with enormous force, the whole structure trembles, and the security team is slowed behind by spray and collapsing debris. Final moment: the two agents reach a safer platform near a control access door while the open spillway roars beside them, with storm, mist, and massive water pressure filling the frame. Daytime during a violent storm. Two agents, one man and one woman, run along the top of a massive concrete dam while a security team chases behind them. The dam is huge and exposed, with narrow maintenance walkways, steel railings, warning lights, control boxes, heavy spray, and roaring water far below. Dark clouds gather overhead, wind drives rain across the structure, and the entire dam feels unstable under growing pressure. Wide opening shot: the two agents sprint along the top of the dam at full speed while security appears behind them, closing in. Water crashes below on one side, and storm wind pushes mist and spray across the walkway. Tracking shot: the agents keep running along the narrow concrete path as warning alarms flash. Ahead, massive spillway gates begin opening one by one. The structure shudders under the force, water erupts downward in huge torrents, and the agents struggle to keep balance on the slick surface. Side shot: the pressure increases. The dam shakes harder as more gates open. Spray blasts across the walkway, metal railings rattle, and one section of the path cracks near the edge. The agents keep moving, ducking around control structures and staying ahead of the security team. Final 5 seconds: the action becomes extreme. A maintenance section ahead partially breaks and drops, creating a gap in the walkway. The agents accelerate into a final desperate sprint, leap across the broken section, land hard, and keep moving while the spillway fully opens beside them. Water explodes downward with enormous force, the whole structure trembles, and the security team is slowed behind by spray and collapsing debris. Final moment: the two agents reach a safer platform near a control access door while the open spillway roars beside them, with storm, mist, and massive water pressure filling the frame. Keep proportions. Keep style and features. Aspect ratio 16:9.

items.description: 一个电影级时尚肖像提示词，用于创作身着雕塑感冰蓝色奇幻兜帽与斗篷的苍白精灵形象。
items.prompt: 创作一张电影级的高级定制奇幻肖像，主体为 {argument name="character age and type" default="一位年轻的中性化精灵模特"}，居中置于纯深灰色摄影棚背景前。主体拥有极其苍白的瓷器般皮肤，鼻梁和脸颊上有淡淡的雀斑，眼神慵懒微闭，眉毛和睫毛呈白色，嘴唇微红，头部两侧长有巨大的尖耳朵。为模特穿上一件超大号的雕塑感兜帽和斗篷，材质为 {argument name="fabric color and texture" default="淡冰蓝灰色褶皱缎面或纸质面料，带有淡淡的大理石纹金色斑点"}。兜帽形成戏剧性的宽三角形轮廓，左右两侧延伸出两个长长的水平角状尖端，将面部框在椭圆形的开口中；材质呈现出褶皱、填充、有机且略带风化的质感。颈部周围是一个厚实的褶皱领，中心用一个小巧的深色扣子系住，柔软的褶皱向下垂落，隐约可见下方裸露的胸部。使用来自左前方的柔和漫射摄影棚灯光，营造柔和的阴影，采用低饱和度的冷色调，浅景深，呈现超细腻的皮肤纹理和织物纤维，具备编辑级高定风格、超现实奇幻写实感、平静忧郁的表情、对称的正面构图、半身剪裁，无文字，除小巧深色扣子外无任何珠宝，背景简洁。

items.prompt: 创作一张精致的特写奇幻肖像，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="一位优雅的年轻女性"}，采用三维层叠水彩纸艺风格。构图为竖向，紧凑地截取面部和肩部，面部略微偏右居中，直视镜头，拥有明亮动人的 {argument name="eye color" default="蓝宝石色"} 双眸、长睫毛、柔和的粉色嘴唇、瓷器般的肌肤以及平静温柔的微笑。她的 {argument name="hair color" default="银灰棕色"} 发丝轻盈且随风飘动，细碎的发丝掠过画面左侧。周围环绕着 6 朵醒目的剪纸花卉元素：顶部有一朵巨大的蓝白花朵形成戏剧性的帽状冠冕，右上角有一朵白色玫瑰状花朵，右脸颊附近有一朵紫白相间的花朵，左肩后方有一簇淡紫色的花朵，左下肩附近有一朵带有金色花蕊的白色花朵，左下方有一簇小白玫瑰。添加撕裂、卷曲的层叠水彩纸条，呈对角线环绕在她的头部和肩部，颜色包括靛蓝、长春花蓝、白色、半透明灰色以及带有金属金色斑点的米色。强调纸张的触感：撕裂的毛边、折叠的花瓣、层叠的剪纸、凸起的阴影、纤维感的水彩纸纹理以及细微的闪光颜料。使用柔和的高调白色背景，带有淡淡的薰衣草色和蓝色晕染、轻盈的虚化效果、细小的白色斑点，以及来自左上方的柔和漫射光。视觉风格应融合优雅的动漫风格美学插画、写实水彩、纸雕拼贴和明亮的编辑肖像艺术。色调保持冷色调且精致，使用 {argument name="accent color" default="钴蓝色"}、柔和的紫罗兰色、珍珠白、温暖的米金色和浅肤色。无文字，无水印，无生硬轮廓，无额外角色。

items.title: 社交媒体帖子 - 手工微缩咖啡馆立体模型
items.description: 生成一个迷人的 3D 微缩咖啡馆场景，采用纸艺与粘土美学，背景为带有趣味涂鸦的大面积纹理纸张。
items.prompt:
创建一个迷人的极简主义 3D 微缩 {argument name="subject" default="咖啡馆"} 场景，灵感源自温馨的手工纸艺与粘土美学。将一家设计精美的小型咖啡店放置在带有纹理的米白色大背景纸的下方中央，周围留出充足的留白空间。

咖啡馆应呈现出手工微缩模型的质感：一个奶油色的小店面，配有温暖的木质柜台、微型浓缩咖啡机、咖啡杯、糕点、咖啡豆、小菜单“项目”、悬挂招牌、盆栽、凳子以及精致的咖啡馆装饰。加入几位正在享用咖啡的微型顾客和柜台后的咖啡师，整体风格保持可爱、精致且整洁。

使用柔和的象牙白、米色、暖棕色、柔和的鼠尾草绿以及微妙的赤陶色作为点缀，呈现逼真的柔和阴影和自然光效。在咖啡馆周围添加微小的手绘黑色涂鸦——如小爱心、蒸汽线、星星、咖啡豆、箭头和简单的装饰符号——营造出一种现代剪贴簿的趣味感。

整体构图应体现出高级、温馨、奇趣、手工制作以及 Instagram/Pinterest 的审美风格，具备触感丰富的纹理纸背景、微缩立体模型外观、细腻的 3D 细节、充足的负空间以及宁静舒适的咖啡馆氛围。4:5 竖构图，高度细节化，简洁优雅，呈现照片级的微缩工艺风格。

items.title: 社交媒体帖子 - 手绘时尚素描拼贴画
items.description: 将合影照片转化为具有剪贴簿/编辑拼贴美感的时尚手绘插画，并保留摄影背景。
items.prompt:
将参考照片中的人物转化为时尚的 {argument name="illustration style" default="手绘时尚插画"}，同时确保他们的面部特征、姿势、表情、发型、服装、身体比例和整体构图清晰可辨。采用混合媒介美学，将写实的摄影背景与人物身上细腻的铅笔和彩色铅笔素描相结合。添加可见的手绘交叉排线、粗犷的铅笔笔触、细腻的墨水轮廓、纹理阴影以及略显不完美的素描细节。服装需保持高度细节，展现真实的布料褶皱和牛仔纹理。

在每个插画人物周围添加厚实的、不规则的白色贴纸/剪纸边框，仿佛是手工逐一剪裁而成。在部分人物边缘添加半透明的白色美纹纸胶带，营造出剪贴簿/编辑拼贴的效果。背景应保持写实、柔和、自然且略带模糊，在摄影环境与插画主体之间形成强烈的对比。

美学风格：{argument name="aesthetic" default="韩系/日系时尚杂志"}，当代街头风格插画，剪贴簿拼贴，时尚素描本，照片级背景 + 手绘角色，干净但不完美的铅笔艺术，舒适柔和的色调，细腻的胶片颗粒感，柔和的自然光，高级时尚杂志质感。

高细节，写实面部，自然人体结构，富有表现力的眼睛，细腻的发丝，真实的服装纹理，干净的构图，全身取景，专业时尚杂志品质。避免过于卡通的比例、CGI 感、过度饱和、手部变形、多余手指、面部扭曲或过于平滑的数字绘画。

若要获得精确的 “{argument name="scene" default="3 位好友同行"}” 效果

请在末尾添加：

三位时尚的年轻人并肩同行，自然互动并注视着彼此，全身镜头，真实的友谊瞬间，城市大学/校园背景，宽松的街头服饰，阔腿牛仔裤和长裤，运动鞋，托特包和双肩包，平视视角拍摄。

items.prompt: 超写实的电影感肖像，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一位 20 出头的英俊年轻男子"}，采用亲密且自然的编辑风格拍摄，灵感源自参考图的构图与温暖的电影氛围，但呈现的是一个完全原创的人物。他拥有浓密、自然的深黑色波浪卷发，略显凌乱地自然垂落在额前；深邃且富有表现力的棕色眼睛，轮廓分明的浓眉，笔挺的鼻梁，突出的颧骨，线条硬朗的男性下颌线，轮廓自然的双唇，以及干净利落的胡茬。他的表情平静、自信、深沉且充满魅力。他身穿 {argument name="clothing" default="一件宽松的高级白色亚麻衬衫"}，领口微敞，展现出自然的织物褶皱和逼真的质感。他随意地坐着，位置 {argument name="setting" default="在一家复古咖啡馆的窗边/门口旁"}，脸庞微微转向温暖的阳光。构图：竖构图肖像，中景至半身取景，主体略微偏离中心，视线看向侧方而非直视镜头。前景包含柔和且失焦的绿叶，营造出优美的自然景深并衬托主体。光影：华丽的午后黄金时刻阳光从侧面射入，面部和发丝带有温暖的高光，柔和的自然阴影，细腻的轮廓光，逼真的皮肤纹理，柔和的电影感对比度。背景：透过门口可见深邃优雅的咖啡馆内景，高度模糊，呈现温暖的棕色与黑色调，带有细微的实用灯光，浅景深效果。摄影：奢华时尚杂志摄影，85mm 人像镜头，f/1.8 大光圈，极浅景深，自然虚化，逼真的皮肤毛孔，细腻的发丝，真实的亚麻质感，细腻的胶片颗粒感，高级的色彩分级，照片级写实，电影感，高动态范围，高端杂志审美，自然随性的氛围，8K 超高清写实。避免：卡通、动漫、塑料感皮肤、过度修图、面部畸变、不自然的眼睛、多余的手指、色彩过饱和、人工感发丝、夸张的肌肉、文字、水印。
items.negativePrompt: 遵循原提示词中的避免项；不要水印、乱码、低清、畸形手、错误透视或主体漂移。

items.title: 个人资料 / 头像 - 真实随意的名人自拍
items.description: 一个旨在创作逼真、略带瑕疵的 iPhone 风格名人自拍的提示词，具有自然光感和抓拍构图。
items.prompt: 拍摄一张极其普通且平平无奇的 iPhone 自拍，没有明确的主体或构图感，就像是一次随意的抓拍。照片带有轻微的运动模糊，以及来自路灯或室内灯光的不均匀照明，导致局部轻微过曝。拍摄角度显得很随意，给人一种刻意平庸的感觉，仿佛是从口袋里掏出手机时心不在焉拍下的。主角是 [uploaded person]，{argument name="celebrity name" default="Dwayne Johnson"} 站在他/她旁边，两人都处于一种随意且不完美的瞬间。背景展示了夜晚热闹的纽约街道，霓虹灯、车流和模糊的路人穿梭而过。整体效果刻意追求平淡和随机，捕捉到那种构图不佳、自发性 iPhone 自拍的真实氛围。

items.title: 个人资料 / 头像 - 淡粉色库尔塔（Kurta）肖像素描
items.description: 生成一幅逼真的铅笔水彩肖像，描绘一位身着传统淡色服饰、神情沉思的南亚男性，适用于优雅的个人资料或编辑类艺术作品。
items.prompt: 创作一幅精致的手绘肖像插画，主角为 {argument name="character description" default="一位 20 多岁、英俊的南亚男性，拥有浓密的黑色波浪卷发、浓眉、杏眼、挺拔的鼻梁、丰满的嘴唇以及修剪整齐的深色胡须"}。采用胸部以上的构图，呈现沉思的三分之二侧面姿势，头部微微转向观众右侧，目光看向一旁，右手食指轻抵唇部和下巴。为他穿上 {argument name="outfit" default="一件柔和的淡粉色传统库尔塔（Kurta），搭配同色系的披肩"}，披肩上带有精致的刺绣花边，呈现细腻的布料褶皱、小巧的前襟纽扣以及高领设计。采用逼真的铅笔炭笔肖像风格，结合细腻的石墨线条、可见的交叉排线、柔和的灰色面部阴影，并仅在衣物上点缀柔和的水彩色彩。皮肤和头发部分保持石墨单色，并呈现出头发和胡须的细腻质感。背景为 {argument name="background" default="纯净的暖米白色纸张纹理"}，光线柔和，无道具、无文字、无水印，且画面中无其他人物。整体氛围宁静、优雅、内敛且浪漫，呈现出高质量时尚肖像素描的质感。

items.title: 个人资料 / 头像 - 阳光下闭眼人像
items.description: 一个用于拍摄女性闭眼沐浴在清晨明媚阳光下，近距离美妆写真的照片级提示词。
items.prompt: 主体：{argument name="subject" default="阳光下闭眼"} 主要主体：一位女性在 {argument name="location" default="白色床铺"} 上的竖构图特写，她仰起脸，在清晨的阳光下闭着双眼。聚焦于面部、颈部和白色蕾丝胸部区域。人物与表情：下巴抬起，双眼紧闭，双唇微张。长长的睫毛，棕色长发向后飘散。服装与姿势：穿着 {argument name="clothing" default="带有细肩带和精致蕾丝饰边的白色吊带裙"}。身体后倾，以强调从面部到颈部的线条。背景与光影：来自右上角窗户的强烈直射阳光。白色毛绒床品，背景中有暖色调灯光。强烈的阴影和明亮的高光。构图与摄影：3:4 竖构图，从胸部到头顶的极致特写，背景高度模糊。质感与风格：高清美妆摄影，突出皮肤光泽和蕾丝质感。负面提示：不要睁眼；不要让面部的仰角过小。

items.prompt:

女孩位于前景中心，

黄衣女孩在右侧，

items.prompt: {"title": "电影感雨夜人像", "description": "一张极具情感张力的电影感人像，透过雨夜霓虹城市中起雾且布满雨水的车窗拍摄。一位美丽的年轻女子独自坐在后座，静静地望向窗外，神情疏离而忧郁。她轻轻在起雾的玻璃上画了一个小爱心，窗外五彩斑斓的城市灯光在雨滴后变得模糊，营造出一种孤独、怀旧与静谧沉思的氛围。", "prompt": "一张电影感雨夜人像，透过起雾且布满雨水的车窗拍摄。一位美丽的年轻女子在暴雨中独自坐在车后座，眼神疏离而忧郁地望向窗外。她用手指在起雾的玻璃上轻轻画了一个小爱心。雨滴顺着窗户流下，使背景中五彩斑斓的城市灯光和霓虹灯招牌产生扭曲。柔和的蓝色与温暖的橙色霓虹反射照亮了她的脸庞和湿润的玻璃。情感孤独，静谧哀伤，电影感叙事，真实的皮肤质感，可见毛孔，自然妆容，略显凌乱的头发，富有表现力的双眼，浅景深，梦幻焦外成像，柔焦效果，逼真的反射，氛围感光影，模拟胶片颗粒，电影级调色，照片级真实感，大师级摄影，超精细，85mm 镜头，f/1.4，获奖人像作品，情感视觉诗意，8k。", "style": [ "电影摄影", "照片级真实感", "模拟胶片美学", "情感视觉叙事", "新黑色电影氛围" ], "negative_prompt": "动漫，卡通，CGI，3D 渲染，低质量，面部模糊，多余的手指，糟糕的解剖结构，不真实的皮肤，色彩过饱和，水印，文字，Logo，人物重复，手部扭曲，塑料感皮肤"}

items.title: 社交媒体帖子 - 夜城沙发肖像
items.description: 一张写实的生活方式肖像，展现了一位女性在沙发上放松，背景是模糊的城市夜景，非常适合电影感 AI 照片生成。
items.prompt: 创作一张写实的电影感夜间肖像，画面中一位年轻女性正坐在高层公寓休息室里一张陈旧的深棕色天鹅绒沙发上放松。她留着长波浪卷发，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="blonde"}，配有柔和的刘海，皮肤白皙，妆容自然，神情平静且略带忧郁，身体斜靠，一只手托着头看向镜头。她穿着一件修身的白色罗纹吊带背心和宽松的灰色抽绳休闲短裤，裤脚有磨损边。她身后是一扇巨大的窗户，展示着模糊的城市夜景，带有绚丽的散景光点和红色的航空障碍灯。在沙发右上方悬挂着衣物：共 4 件，分别为一件黑色大衣、一件黑色夹克、一件蓝色牛仔夹克和一件黑白条纹衬衫。从右侧加入温暖的环境灯光，与窗外冷蓝色的城市灯光形成对比。在前景的矮桌上，放置 3 件失焦的饮品：左下方附近是一个绿色玻璃瓶，右侧是两个装有金色啤酒和白色泡沫的大啤酒杯。采用浅景深、真实的皮肤纹理、柔和的阴影、私密的情绪化氛围，35mm 生活方式摄影风格，横向构图，无文字，无水印。

items.title: 社交媒体帖子 - 奢华时尚杂志风男士肖像
items.description: 生成一张写实的高端生活方式肖像，展示一位时尚男士坐于奢华现代室内空间中，适用于时尚或个人品牌视觉呈现。
items.prompt: 创作一张超写实的高端生活方式肖像，主角为 {argument name="subject" default="一位年轻的黑人男性"}，自信地坐在一处奢华的现代室内空间中，采用精致的时尚杂志风格进行拍摄。主体位于全景垂直构图的中心，放松地坐在配有黑白千鸟格软垫的黑色真皮休闲椅上。他身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="一套全黑传统长袖束腰外衣及配套长裤，并佩戴黑色帽子"}，戴着透明细框眼镜、银色腕表、金戒指，脚穿棕色皮革交叉带凉鞋。让他双腿分开，以冷静自信的姿态坐着，一手拿着智能手机，另一只手看着手腕上的表，表情严肃而沉稳。场景设定在 {argument name="interior setting" default="一个拥有抛光大理石地面、米色大理石墙板、深色垂直木条装饰以及缠绕着暖色调装饰灯的棕榈树的奢华大堂"}。画面中需包含三个显眼的家具/装饰元素：带图案的休闲椅、他身后发光的棕榈树，以及右侧边缘一张带有金色饰边的圆形白色长笛纹边桌。使用暖色调环境光、柔和的阴影、光洁的地板反射、浅景深时尚摄影效果、自然的皮肤纹理、逼真的织物褶皱、高级时尚杂志调色，并采用清晰的 4:5 垂直裁剪。画面中不得包含文字、Logo、水印、额外人物，或扭曲的手部和脚部。

items.prompt: 创作一张迷人的高级时尚摄影棚肖像，主角是一位年轻女性，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="蓬松的深栗棕色"} 凌乱波浪肩长发，拥有白皙透亮的皮肤、迷人的榛灰色眼睛、柔和的拱形眉毛、精致的暖色调眼妆，以及光泽感十足的深 {argument name="lipstick color" default="绯红色"} 唇妆。她穿着一件厚实的罗纹 {argument name="sweater color" default="红色"} 高领毛衣，领口高耸，针织纹理清晰可见。采用四分之三半身像构图，肩膀向左倾斜，下巴微微抬起，双唇微张，自信而性感地直视镜头。使用与迷人红色主题相呼应的无缝 {argument name="background color" default="深浓红色"} 摄影棚背景。光线柔和而富有戏剧性，面部采用平滑的美容碟灯光照明，下颌下方有柔和的阴影，眼睛中有细腻的眼神光，皮肤质感真实。构图为 3:4 竖幅，从上半身到发顶的紧凑裁剪，略微偏右居中，编辑类时尚摄影风格，超写实，浅景深，无首饰，无文字，无水印。
items.negativePrompt: 遵循原提示词中的避免项；不要水印、乱码、低清、畸形手、错误透视或主体漂移。

items.title: 个人资料 / 头像 - Y2K 可爱风马卡龙色肖像
items.description: 生成一张柔和的 Y2K 风格马卡龙色系影棚肖像，搭配可爱的时尚造型，非常适合作为头像或美妆杂志大片。
items.prompt: 创作一张方形的 Y2K 可爱风影棚特写肖像，主角是一位年轻女性，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深黑棕色"} 略显凌乱的及肩发和空气刘海，眼神灵动地看向侧上方，嘟着俏皮的鸭子嘴。背景为平滑的马卡龙薰衣草紫，光线柔和均匀，呈现出梦幻般的美妆杂志质感。造型搭配：一顶淡粉蓝色针织帽（带有两个圆圆的熊耳朵）、一件带有白色饰边和领口小蝴蝶结的浅蓝色罗纹吊带背心、一条带有心形小吊坠的银色项链，以及长款毛绒露指袖套（带有粉色、蓝色、紫色、黄色和桃色的横向马卡龙彩虹条纹）。双手对称抬起，食指轻轻按在脸颊上。在双颊贴上总共约 16 枚粉色、蓝色、黄色和薰衣草紫的小星星贴纸。妆容要求柔和且富有光泽：粉色腮红、细腻的微光眼影、根根分明的睫毛、自然水光肌以及闪亮的粉色嘴唇。采用浅景深效果，面部细节清晰，色彩呈现柔和的胶片质感，高分辨率时尚摄影风格，营造出怀旧的 21 世纪初日本偶像肖像氛围，可爱且精致，画面中无文字或水印。
items.negativePrompt: 遵循原提示词中的避免项；不要水印、乱码、低清、畸形手、错误透视或主体漂移。

items.title: 个人资料 / 头像 - 优雅的年轻女性铅笔肖像
items.description: 生成一幅精致的黑白石墨风格肖像，描绘了一位神情宁静、长发飘逸且姿态优雅的年轻女性。
items.prompt: 创作一幅简洁的黑白铅笔肖像插画，描绘一位神情宁静的年轻女性，正脸朝向前方，居中置于纯白色背景上。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="以浅色石墨线条呈现的极浅金色"} 的长发，中分发型，秀发垂落在双肩，呈现出许多细腻的发丝线条和柔和的波浪质感。她的脸型呈柔和的椭圆形，五官对称，拥有杏仁状的大眼睛、轮廓分明的天然眉毛、精致挺直的鼻梁、丰满且轻闭的双唇、柔和的下颌线、平滑的双颊以及细腻逼真的阴影。画面展示她从胸部以上的部分，双肩裸露，呈现优雅的一字肩姿态，右手斜放在胸前，五指清晰可见，指甲修剪整齐。采用精致的石墨线条艺术、细致的轮廓线、细腻的交叉排线、极浅的色调阴影、高调的白色留白，呈现出时尚素描的写实感，且不含任何色彩。保持构图简洁优雅，头部位于顶部中心，头发占据画面两侧，手部作为唯一的突出元素。画面中无文字、无珠宝、无背景物体、无生硬阴影、无水印。
items.negativePrompt: 遵循原提示词中的避免项；不要水印、乱码、低清、畸形手、错误透视或主体漂移。

items.title: 个人资料 / 头像 - 温馨动漫书店店员肖像
items.description: 生成一张温馨的竖版动漫肖像，描绘了在灯光暖黄的日本书店中微笑的店员，适用于角色设计或视觉小说概念。
items.prompt: 创作一张竖版动漫风格肖像，描绘一位年轻的日本书店店员，背景位于灯光暖黄的书店过道中。构图为居中的半身特写，她面向观众，带着温柔的浅笑，眼神棕色且富有表现力。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="暖深棕色"} 的短波波头，带有轻盈的波浪感，额前有稀疏的刘海和细碎的发丝，发顶有温暖的轮廓光。她身穿一件略带褶皱的米色衬衫，外罩一件海军蓝书店围裙，围裙带有肩带、金属扣，胸前印有白色“BOOKS”小标志，并别着一个长方形员工名牌，上面写有日文「店员」及名字「貝渕」。添加小巧的耳钉和自然的红润脸颊。她左下角的手中拿着一本书，为青绿色精装本，封面上印有竖排日文标题。背景是柔焦处理的书店内部，两侧是书架，温暖的顶灯营造出圆形的散景效果，左侧有一个虚化的日文大招牌，写着「文庫・新書」和「話題の本」。采用电影感的黄金时段室内光效，略暗的温馨曝光，浅景深，细腻的绘画风动漫渲染，精致的皮肤阴影，逼真的布料褶皱，柔和的琥珀色高光，营造出宁静亲密的氛围。画布比例 2:3，竖向构图。避免出现多余角色，避免现代 UI 元素，避免水印，除名牌和围裙标志外，保持所有背景文字模糊。

items.title: 个人资料 / 头像 - 电影感动漫风休息室肖像
items.description: 生成一张优雅女性斜倚在沙发上的动漫风格私密肖像，配以温暖的焦外成像光效，适用于角色概念设计。
items.prompt: 创作一张电影感的动漫风格肖像，描绘一位优雅的年轻女性在夜晚昏暗的豪华休息室中，侧身斜倚在深色花纹沙发上的场景。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="栗棕色短发"}，凌乱的波波头配以柔和的刘海，拥有一双温暖的棕色眼睛、精致的五官、光泽的双唇，注视着观众时带着平静而亲密的浅笑。她的一只手臂弯曲靠在沙发背上，另一只手臂自然放松地放在身前；采用略微俯视的角度，展示四分之三的上半身构图。她穿着 {argument name="dress color" default="深海军蓝缎面吊带裙"}，细肩带和低领设计，身上佩戴恰好 2 件可见饰品：一条带有小吊坠的精致银色项链，以及可见耳朵上的一枚十字架吊坠耳环。使用温暖的琥珀色实用光，头发和肩部带有柔和的轮廓光，逼真的皮肤阴影，绘画感的动漫渲染，细腻的织物光泽，以及浅景深效果，背景是黑暗中模糊的大光斑。整体氛围应亲密、优雅、宁静且具有电影感，画面包含丰富的阴影，无文字，无水印，无多余角色。

items.title: 个人资料 / 头像 - 手持 1 万日元的帝国公主
items.description: 一个电影感肖像提示词，用于生成一位华丽的金色帝国公主，她手持一张日本 1 万日元纸币并做出俏皮的剪刀手姿势。
items.prompt: 创作一张高分辨率的竖构图肖像照片，画面中心是一位年轻的东亚女性，她装扮成华丽的古代帝国公主，直视镜头，双眼灵动有神。她身穿一件奢华的米金色刺绣汉服风格长袍，内衬红色，饰有华丽的花卉金锦，腰间系着带有绿玉装饰的结构化金腰带，袖口宽大飘逸。她的发型是高耸的正式发髻，配有齐刘海，头戴极其精致的金色凤凰花卉冠冕，饰有花丝、珍珠、水滴状宝石、垂下的珍珠链和流苏。她双手举至肩部高度，做出两个 V 字剪刀手姿势，分别位于脸部两侧。一张写实的日本 1 万日元纸币横向衔在嘴前，像俏皮的口塞一样遮住嘴唇；纸币应清晰显示巨大的“10000”面额和日本纸币的样式。背景是奢华的金色宫殿内部，灯光温暖呈琥珀色，配有雕花深色木板、发光的灯笼、焦外成像光斑，左侧模糊可见金龙雕塑，营造出浓郁的帝国氛围。使用电影感暖色调调色、浅景深、清晰的面部细节、真实的皮肤纹理、对称构图、华丽的纹理和超精细的珠宝。氛围华丽、俏皮且奢华，如同高端时尚 Cosplay 专题大片。自定义主体为 {argument name="character name" default="年轻的东亚帝国公主"}，服装配色为 {argument name="outfit color palette" default="米色、金色和红色"}，嘴部道具为 {argument name="mouth prop" default="日本 1 万日元纸币"}，背景设置为 {argument name="background setting" default="奢华的金色宫殿内部"}，手部动作为 {argument name="hand pose" default="两个 V 字剪刀手姿势"}。
items.negativePrompt: 遵循原提示词中的避免项；不要水印、乱码、低清、畸形手、错误透视或主体漂移。

items.title: 个人资料 / 头像 - 元气满满的 AI-Tuber 动漫少女
items.description: 一张充满活力的 AI-Tuber 少女半身动漫主视觉图，适用于 VTuber 品牌形象、个人资料头像或透明贴纸。
items.prompt: 创作一张背景透明或纯白、构图为半身的精致动漫风格角色插画。主体是一位元气满满的年轻女性 AI-Tuber 偶像，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深亮紫色"} 的高侧马尾，发丝飘逸且带有光泽感，拥有琥珀金色的双眸、灿烂的露齿笑容、淡淡的腮红，姿态友好且热情。她身体略微朝向观众，位于画布右侧，左臂向左侧伸展，手掌张开，仿佛正在展示某物。她身穿一件青色 T 恤，上面印有醒目的白色文字 {argument name="shirt text" default="AITuber"}，下摆束进高腰浅色牛仔短裤或长裤中，外搭一件亮青色的大廓形蓬松夹克，夹克上有粉色的大圆贴片和宽大的蓝色袖口。添加 3 种可见的配饰：刘海上印有 {argument name="hair clip text" default="AI"} 字样的黄色发夹、单耳上佩戴的多个小金圈耳环，以及束住马尾的深色发圈。采用精致的现代日系动漫渲染风格，线条清晰，色彩鲜艳饱和，使用柔和的赛璐珞阴影，发丝细节丰富，眼睛明亮，肤色干净，呈现出轻快活泼的 VTuber 主视觉质感。保持背景简洁、无杂物，适合进行透明化处理；无需背景场景，无需额外角色，禁止添加水印。
items.negativePrompt: 遵循原提示词中的避免项；不要水印、乱码、低清、畸形手、错误透视或主体漂移。

items.title: 个人资料 / 头像 - 电影级奢华家庭影院肖像
items.description: 一个用于生成奢华家庭影院场景中女性写实电影肖像的高细节提示词，强调光影、质感和自信的表情。
items.prompt: 超写实电影肖像，主角为 {argument name="character role" default="成年女性"}，侧身斜倚在 {argument name="furniture item" default="巨大的现代影院沙发"} 上。她身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="修身的深绯红色连衣裙"}，外搭一件超大号炭黑色夹克，夹克松垮地挂在肩头，脚蹬与裙子同色系、采用相同华丽皮革工艺的绯红色及膝搭扣靴。她身体微微前倾，单手肘支撑头部。保持前景大腿的突出透视感和自然的坐姿结构。留着凌乱的黑色短波波头，皮肤纹理真实。她的表情极具诱惑力且自信：温暖而微妙的微笑，双唇微启，眼神坚定有力，狭长的双眼流露出鲜活而迷人的目光。昏暗的奢华家庭影院，巨大的灰色组合沙发，后方为阶梯式座位，深色现代建筑风格，温暖的垂直墙壁灯光，柔和的投影仪光晕，电影感但真实的灯光效果，高细节智能手机摄影，自然质感，无塑料感皮肤，无畸形解剖结构。

items.title: 个人资料 / 头像 - 奢华生日影棚人像
items.description: 生成一张优雅的影棚生日人像，画面中是一个穿着考究的孩子，坐在白色底座上，周围环绕着黑色、白色和透明气球。
items.prompt: 创作一张超写实的奢华影棚生日人像，主角为 {argument name="subject" default="一名年轻的黑人男孩"}，他自信地坐在一个大型哑光白色长方形底座上，位于竖构图的中心。他直视镜头，露出灿烂自然的微笑，坐姿端正，双手舒适地放在膝盖上，双腿垂在底座边缘。为他穿上一套精致的 {argument name="outfit" default="黑色燕尾服，搭配缎面翻领、白色衬衫、黑色领结、黑色长裤和黑色亮面乐福鞋"}。使用暖焦糖棕色的无缝影棚背景，采用柔和的专业灯光，在底座和鞋子下方投下柔和的阴影，呈现出精美的编辑摄影质感，对焦清晰，皮肤纹理真实，西装和气球上有细腻的高光。在场景周围布置极简主义的白色展示块：一个他所坐的大型中央底座，左下方一个部分可见的白色底座，右侧一个高窄的白色底座，以及最右侧一个部分可见的更高底座。添加 2 组气球布置：左侧是一个放置在细支架上的透明超大泡泡气球，内部包含 5 个小气球（4 个黑色，1 个白色），系着白色蝴蝶结和长长的黑白流苏；右侧是一簇漂浮的氦气球，共 7 个可见气球（4 个黑色，3 个珍珠白），系着细黑白绳和卷曲的白色丝带。保持场景优雅、喜庆且高端，画面中不含任何文字、蛋糕、蜡烛、水印或其他多余道具。使用 2:3 的竖向人像裁剪比例，全身可见，从头部到鞋子。
items.negativePrompt: 遵循原提示词中的避免项；不要水印、乱码、低清、畸形手、错误透视或主体漂移。

items.prompt: 创作一幅高度细节化的半写实数字绘画，主角是 {argument name="character description" default="一位美丽的南亚年轻女性"}，采用胸部以上的正面特写肖像，肩膀呈柔和的四分之三侧角。她留着长而蓬松的波浪卷发，{argument name="hair color" default="深黑色头发带有细微的棕色挑染"}，中分偏侧，拥有温暖的自然肤色、富有表现力的棕色眼睛、优雅的深色眉毛、柔和的玫瑰色嘴唇和淡淡的微笑。在鼻翼处添加一枚精致的小型花卉鼻饰，双耳各佩戴一枚华丽的金色 jhumka 耳环，并带有珍珠般的垂坠珠饰。为她穿上 {argument name="clothing" default="带有细微金边和透明深色披肩的黑色纱丽"}，在肩膀和胸前可见。使用柔和的摄影棚灯光、写实的皮肤纹理、平滑的绘画融合效果、细腻的发丝，呈现精致的印度民族时尚肖像美学。背景为干净的白色，身后带有抽象的灰色笔触，下半身和衣物周围呈现未完成的绘画笔触边缘。构图应为垂直、居中、优雅、高分辨率，无文字，无水印，无额外人物，且无过度卡通化的特征。

items.rawText: 创作一幅高度细节化的半写实数字绘画，主角是 {argument name="character description" default="一位美丽的南亚年轻女性"}，采用胸部以上的正面特写肖像，肩膀呈柔和的四分之三侧角。她留着长而蓬松的波浪卷发，{argument name="hair color" default="深黑色头发带有细微的棕色挑染"}，中分偏侧，拥有温暖的自然肤色、富有表现力的棕色眼睛、优雅的深色眉毛、柔和的玫瑰色嘴唇和淡淡的微笑。在鼻翼处添加一枚精致的小型花卉鼻饰，双耳各佩戴一枚华丽的金色 jhumka 耳环，并带有珍珠般的垂坠珠饰。为她穿上 {argument name="clothing" default="带有细微金边和透明深色披肩的黑色纱丽"}，在肩膀和胸前可见。使用柔和的摄影棚灯光、写实的皮肤纹理、平滑的绘画融合效果、细腻的发丝，呈现精致的印度民族时尚肖像美学。背景为干净的白色，身后带有抽象的灰色笔触，下半身和衣物周围呈现未完成的绘画笔触边缘。构图应为垂直、居中、优雅、高分辨率，无文字，无水印，无额外人物，且无过度卡通化的特征。

items.description: 一张居中的可爱虎斑猫贴纸插画，配有日文标题，适合用于创作 LINE 贴纸。
items.prompt: 在正方形白色画布上创作一张可爱的 LINE 贴纸风格插画，画面主体是一只胖乎乎的虎斑猫，正开心地坐在一个柔软的米色坐垫上。这只猫拥有 {argument name="fur color" default="暖棕色和奶油色的虎斑毛发"}，头部、身体、四肢和粗壮的卷曲尾巴上有深色的圆形条纹，闭着眼睛微笑，有着细小的胡须、腮红般的脸颊，其中一只前爪抬起，仿佛在踩奶或挥手。采用柔和的可爱数字插画风格，线条为干净的深棕色，带有柔和的赛璐珞阴影，造型圆润，在纯白背景下呈现出简约的透明贴纸感。在角色下方正中央放置一行简短的黑色小字日文标题：{argument name="caption text" default="ふみふみ"}。保持构图简洁并居中，留出充足的空白，不要添加额外的道具、边框、水印或任何其他文字。

items.title: 个人资料 / 头像 - 黑白宠物工作室肖像
items.description: 这是一个为 GPT Image 2 设计的编辑风格黑白工作室肖像提示词，重点表现人与宠物猫之间的亲密互动。
items.prompt: 使用附件参考图中的人物，创作一张超写实的 9:16 黑白工作室肖像。保留其准确的面部特征、五官、胡须、比例、表情以及自然的皮肤纹理。人物坐在极简主义的工作室地板上，怀抱着一只 {argument name="pet" default="大型家猫"}。一条腿弯曲向身体靠拢，另一条腿沿地板对角线伸展。一只手臂托住猫咪，另一只手放在抬起的膝盖上，头部微微向手臂一侧倾斜。人物和猫咪均直视镜头。保持姿势自然、放松、亲密且具有编辑风格。穿着 {argument name="top clothing" default="轻薄宽松的棉质 T 恤"} 和 {argument name="bottom clothing" default="深色质感牛仔裤"}。保留可见的纹身、逼真的织物褶皱、接缝和自然皱纹。使用柔和的侧前向工作室灯光，营造平滑的阴影和自然的亮部。背景保持干净、明亮、简洁，呈现无缝背景墙效果。超写实 RAW 摄影，焦点清晰，逼真的皮肤微纹理，细腻的毛发，自然的解剖结构，逼真的织物纹理，丰富的灰度色调，自然的阴影，纪录片式时尚编辑风格，8K 细节。禁止使用 CGI、塑料感皮肤、皮肤平滑处理、美颜滤镜、过度修图、解剖结构扭曲、多余的手指或肢体、添加家具、配饰或背景物体。
items.negativePrompt: 遵循原提示词中的避免项；不要水印、乱码、低清、畸形手、错误透视或主体漂移。

items.title: 个人资料 / 头像 - 电影感黑色电影风格男性肖像
items.description: 一张高对比度、超写实的黑白肖像，刻画了一位留着短胡须的年轻男子，呈现出戏剧性的明暗对比照明和精致的美学风格。
items.prompt:
超写实的电影感肖像，主角为一位引人注目的 {argument name="subject" default="20 岁出头的年轻男子"}，灵感源自参考图像中戏剧性的低角度构图、暗黑氛围、强烈的单色美学以及高对比度照明。

他拥有浓密且自然卷曲的乌黑头发，略显湿润并向后梳理，深邃的眼睛极具表现力，眉毛浓密且充满阳刚之气，鼻梁笔挺，颧骨突出，下颌线条轮廓分明，留着修剪整齐的短胡须，每一根胡须都清晰可见。自然的皮肤毛孔和细腻的面部纹理清晰可见。

他微微向后倾斜，头部向上仰起，双眼轻闭，营造出一种冷静、神秘、自信且具有电影感的表情。头发自然地垂落在脸部两侧。他身穿一件奢华的黑色纹理大衣，领子立起，展现出精致的暗黑时尚外观。

使用戏剧性的侧光，照亮他半边脸庞，而另一半则隐没在深邃的阴影中。强烈的明暗对比，头发周围有微妙的轮廓光，深邃的黑色，明亮的银色高光，以及极其细腻的面部轮廓。

背景几乎全黑，经过深度模糊处理，带有微妙的远方城市灯光和柔和的圆形光斑。在他周围添加非常细微的大气雾气/烟雾，以增加深度和电影氛围。

摄影风格：超写实、高端编辑摄影、电影感黑色电影、单色黑白、戏剧性明暗对比、深邃对比度、浅景深、{argument name="lens" default="85mm"} 镜头、f/1.4 光圈、真实的胶片颗粒感、自然的皮肤纹理、锐利的面部细节、专业影棚灯光、照片级真实感、8K 画质。

构图：4:5 竖构图肖像，近景至中景取景，低机位拍摄，主体占据画面大部分空间，电影感留白，精致的暗黑奢华美学。
items.negativePrompt: 遵循原提示词中的避免项；不要水印、乱码、低清、畸形手、错误透视或主体漂移。

items.prompt:
创作一幅极具吸引力、超写实的特写肖像，主角为自然状态下的 {argument name="subject" default="美丽的年轻女性"}，旨在营造出让人瞬间“停止滑动”的视觉冲击力。

镜头极度贴近她的面部，捕捉她深棕色眼眸中那令人着迷的温润感，并将其作为不可忽视的视觉焦点。她的双眼必须看起来栩栩如生且极度逼真，呈现出复杂的虹膜纹理、细微的天然血丝、水润的眼线、清晰的眼神光，以及根根分明的睫毛。

她的美是原始、真实且不完美的——脸颊和鼻梁上自然散布着雀斑，展现出真实的毛孔、细微的绒毛、细小的美人痣、自然的皮肤纹理以及细腻的肤色变化。请勿将她的皮肤处理得过于平滑。她的一侧眉毛上方有一道细长的自然愈合疤痕，脸颊处也有一道淡淡的愈合疤痕，为这幅肖像增添了神秘且令人难忘的个性。

她长长的 {argument name="hair color" default="乌黑亮丽的秀发"} 自然地垂落在脸庞周围，几缕发丝轻柔地掠过额头和脸颊。她的眉毛浓密，形状自然，细节刻画入微。柔软、自然的粉色双唇微微放松，营造出一种随性而非刻意摆拍的表情。

病毒式传播的关键：捕捉她看向镜头的那一瞬间，仿佛她刚刚注意到观看者。她的表情平静、神秘且具有情感磁力——在微妙的脆弱感中交织着沉静的自信。观看者应感受到仿佛偶然捕捉到了一个私密且一生难遇的瞬间。

光影采用 {argument name="lighting type" default="柔和的电影感日光"}，从一侧射入，在她的眼睛、颧骨和皮肤上投射出明亮的高光，同时保留真实的阴影。

构图：极端的面部特写，眼睛位于视觉中心附近，面部几乎填满整个画面，采用略微非传统的倾斜拍摄角度，营造亲密的视角、自然的非对称感以及写实的面部比例。
items.negativePrompt: 遵循原提示词中的避免项；不要水印、乱码、低清、畸形手、错误透视或主体漂移。

items.title: 社交媒体帖子 - 高级披萨广告海报
items.description: 一份高度详细的广告提示词，用于创作 Instagram 代理商级别的食品海报，侧重于品牌塑造、质感和创意构图。
items.prompt:
创意方向
创作一张高级、代理商级别的 {argument name="brand" default="DOMINO'S"} 广告海报，灵感源自大胆的 QSR / FMCG 社交媒体活动的视觉语言：强烈的图形构图、一眼即懂的视觉隐喻、受控的产品摄影、以品牌饱和色为主调的整体视觉、简洁的留白、真实的食物质感、短小精悍的堆叠排版以及轮播图系统的连贯性。
请勿复制任何特定的参考构图。
提取通用原则并构建原创作品。
海报必须呈现出真实全球披萨广告活动的感觉，由商业食品摄影师进行艺术指导，而非通用的 AI 食品海报。

视觉效果必须在观众阅读文案之前传达出核心理念。

活动基因
品牌：{argument name="brand" default="DOMINO'S"}
核心产品：{argument name="product" default="招牌意大利辣香肠 / 芝士披萨"}，采用正宗的 Domino's 包装语言
活动领域：渴望 + 配送胜利
概念：盒子即胜利 (THE BOX IS THE WIN)
个性：饥饿、俏皮、自信、快速、略带调皮
色彩系统
- 主色调 {argument name="color" default="红色 (#E31837)"}
- Domino's 蓝色 (#006491) 仅用于 Logo、包装盒点缀、小型图形标点
- 白色
- 柔和的奶油色 / 马苏里拉芝士高光
- 克制的深红色阴影
红色必须立即占据画面主导地位。它看起来不应像通用的番茄酱广告。

创意执行
图形视觉隐喻 + 高级披萨主角 + QSR 社交海报
使用：
- 超大号短排版
- 产品比例
- 品牌红色的重复
- 留白
- 一个梗 / 一个物体关系
- 受控的蒸汽和芝士光泽
- 强烈的对齐感
避免环境纪实风格。除非特定画面需要手部/托盘，否则不要使用街头生活方式的电影剧照风格。

背景
完全受控的广告领域。
浓郁饱和的 Domino's 红，带有微妙的色调深度。
允许：
- 极度微妙的斑点 / 意大利辣香肠圆点图案，对比度极低
- 克制的径向衰减
- 柔和的立体阴影
禁止：
- 默认使用随意的餐厅内部场景
- 脏乱的厨房
- 城市街道
- 杂乱的拼贴
- 额外的品牌

核心产品
照片级真实的 Domino's 披萨，作为最重要的实体对象。
保留可识别的 Domino's 包装盒 / Logo 几何形状。不要发明新 Logo。不要重新设计字标。
展示：
- 融化的马苏里拉芝士
- 意大利辣香肠油脂
- 逼真的饼皮气泡
- 可见的蒸汽，需克制
- 包装盒在画面中时，需呈现真实的瓦楞纸披萨盒质感
- 可信的油光，而非塑料感的 CGI
产品占据约 50%–65% 的画面宽度，除非创意需要比例对比。

排版系统
标题：简短，3–6 个词，粗体现代无衬线字体 / 厚重无衬线字体。
主标题为白色。
一个钩子词可以是奶油黄色。
副标题较小、较安静。
可选底部锁定：以黄色小胶囊形式呈现的“立即下单” (ORDER NOW)。
可选页脚：热乎。快速。属于你。 (Hot. Fast. Yours.)
排版是层级，而非装饰。
不要用文案填满画面。

items.title: 社交媒体帖子 - 夜间骑马篝火抓拍照片
items.description: 生成一张超写实的竖版 iPhone 风格夜间照片，展现一名男子骑在马上，在篝火旁与朋友欢笑的场景。
items.prompt: 创作一张原始、自然的竖版 iPhone 夜间抓拍照片，主角为 {argument name="subject" default="一位 35 岁、肤色红润的欧洲男性"}，他正骑在 {argument name="horse color" default="一匹白灰色马"} 上，身处黑暗森林中的小型篝火聚会旁。男子位于画面中心偏右，采用近距离中低角度拍摄，无鞍或使用深色马鞍骑行，双手握着黑色缰绳。他正处于大笑中，露出牙齿，看向画面左侧的朋友，神态轻松且富有魅力。他留着凌乱的棕色头发，留着浅浅的胡茬，皮肤黝黑，身穿一件米白色亚麻衬衫，内搭奶油色针织 T 恤，下身穿蓝色牛仔裤，佩戴深色手表。马头占据右侧前景，截取至口鼻部和颈部，可见耳朵、鬃毛、笼头、缰绳以及皮毛上柔软的灰色斑点。在左侧背景中，准确展示三位围坐在篝火旁的朋友：最左侧是一位身穿浅色衬衫的人正在微笑，中间后方是一位深色头发的人拿着饮料，靠近火堆处是一位身穿深色衬衫的男子正在大笑。在发光的炭火上方加入一个小烤架，火焰升腾，烟雾向上飘散，附近摆放着餐盘或露营食物，左下角前景处有一盏温暖的灯笼在发光。使用 {argument name="lighting" default="深黑色森林阴影下的温暖火光和灯笼光"}，带有细微的动态模糊、高 ISO 噪点、不完美的手机闪光灯/低光曝光、真实的皮肤纹理、抓拍构图、浅景深，避免任何摆拍的影棚感。纵横比为竖版 2:3，超写实，色彩自然，无文字，无水印。
items.negativePrompt: 遵循原提示词中的避免项；不要水印、乱码、低清、畸形手、错误透视或主体漂移。

items.title: 社交媒体帖子 - 日式咖啡馆记忆手账页面
items.description: 一个创意提示词，用于生成结合了写实咖啡馆摄影与同场景水彩插画的编辑风格日记排版。
items.prompt: 创建一个高级编辑风格的“记忆手账”页面，将真实的日常生活摄影与同一瞬间的手绘插画结合起来。使用 4:5 的竖构图，通过对角线或垂直线将其分为两个互补的部分：左侧是一张温暖、自然、带有轻微胶片颗粒感的 {argument name="scene" default="日式咖啡馆场景"} 照片，展示木桌上摆放精美的食物或甜点与咖啡，呈现真实的咖啡馆环境细节、柔和的窗光、浅景深以及微妙的怀旧色调；右侧是一个极简主义的 {argument name="art style" default="手绘水彩/彩色铅笔插画"}，用细腻且带有不完美感的墨线、柔和的大地色系、可见的纸张纹理以及手工艺术感重现同样的食物与饮品。右侧大部分区域保留温暖的象牙色纹理纸张，并留出充足的负空间。在插画下方，添加小巧的打字机风格存档文字，内容包含 {argument name="location and date" default="日本东京 / No. 0018 / 咖啡 / 吐司 / 静谧时光 / 2026"}。整体设计应呈现出精心策划的日本旅行日记、咖啡馆记忆档案、现代剪贴簿和复古生活杂志的质感，采用精致的编辑排版、暖奶油色纸张、柔和的青色、棕色、米色及灰调色彩，辅以细腻的颗粒感、不完美的印刷效果、低调的排版、真实的纸张触感、优雅的极简主义，将照片级写实摄影与手工插画无缝融合，细节丰富，视觉叙事连贯，无 Logo，无水印。
items.negativePrompt: 遵循原提示词中的避免项；不要水印、乱码、低清、畸形手、错误透视或主体漂移。

items.description: 一个用于创作东方风格海报的提示词，侧重于春季色彩和简洁的极简主义布局。
items.prompt:
主题：东方禅意极简封面海报
风格：明亮女性审美
主体：{argument name="subject" default="一位传统的中国女性站在圆形花窗旁，手持一朵小花"}
氛围：甜美、明亮、轻松的春日气息
意象：圆形窗户、荔枝粉花朵、青苹果绿叶、暖白色留白、女性剪影
构图：主体位于右下角，圆形窗户居中上方作为视觉焦点，左侧/顶部留有充足的标题空间
配色方案：奶油白背景，花朵/服装采用荔枝粉点缀，叶片采用青苹果绿，服装颜色为 {argument name="outfit color" default="浅米色或淡粉色"}；避免使用整体滤镜
光影：明亮的自然光，干净的扁平插画感，边缘清晰，{argument name="texture" default="细腻的纸张纹理"}
比例：9:16
备注：整体色彩甜美干净，适合社交媒体，无需雾气或陈旧纸张效果
