items.prompt: 请使用我上传的面部图像作为主要身份参考。请 100% 精确保留我的面部特征、脸型、发型、发质、胡须风格、肤色、眼型、眉毛、鼻子、嘴唇以及所有独特的面部细节，确保最高准确度。为我创作一张写实的电影感黑白街头时尚人像 {argument name="pose" default="夜晚坐在城市金属逃生楼梯上"}。构图和氛围需与参考图保持一致：我随意坐着，单膝抬起，身体微微前倾，表情放松且自信。我穿着 {argument name="clothing" default="全黑套装——黑色开领衬衫、黑色长裤和时尚运动鞋"}。佩戴一副精致的太阳镜，打造酷炫的都市造型。场景应具备 {argument name="mood" default="阴郁的暗色调氛围，背景为高层建筑，模糊的城市灯光，夜间城市环境"}，呈现戏剧性的阴影、深邃的对比度以及 35mm 胶片摄影的颗粒感。使其看起来像是一张奢华的时尚杂志大片，写实摄影，自然姿态，纹理细腻，面部焦点清晰，电影级布光。

items.title: 个人资料 / 头像 - 高角度编辑风格人像
items.description: 一张超写实主义的近景美妆人像，展现了一位拥有浅绿色双眸且皮肤纹理自然的成年女性。
items.prompt:
一位清晰的成年女性高角度近景特写，构图范围从额头到锁骨。深色的中分长发柔和地修饰着脸庞。{argument name="eye color" default="浅绿色双眸"} 是画面的视觉焦点，呈现出自然的睫毛、眉毛和眼神光。

写实的白皙皮肤展现出毛孔、细小的痣、微妙的不对称感以及淡淡的粉色腮红。柔和的粉色双唇自然放松，微微张开。柔和的顶光在额头、鼻梁和颧骨处营造出细腻的高光，并伴有自然的阴影。

背景为淡浅蓝色，左侧可见清晰的白色衣领。超写实美妆人像，85mm 镜头，f/1.4 光圈，浅景深，自然皮肤纹理，精致的编辑级清晰度。--ar 4:5 --quality high --no 改变瞳色、双眼不对称、多余眼睛、面部扭曲、塑料感皮肤、过度修图、人工对称、强烈的 HDR、CGI、卡通、严重模糊。

items.title: 个人资料 / 头像 - 专业个人品牌肖像集
items.description: 一份用于创建八张风格各异、具备编辑级品质的个人品牌肖像的综合提示词。
items.prompt: 使用上传的参考图像作为面部特征的唯一来源，创建一套出色的个人品牌肖像集。以最高保真度保留人物身份：精确的面部结构、眼睛形状与颜色、鼻子、嘴唇、下颌线、耳朵、发型、胡须、肤色、自然的皮肤纹理以及独特的面部特征。请勿进行美化、重塑、瘦脸、衰老、减龄或替换面部特征。设计一张高级的 A4 竖版肖像展示页，包含 8 张风格各异的编辑级照片，而非重复的头像。每张图像都必须清晰地呈现同一个人。肖像概念：1. 执行官：一张强有力的四分之三侧身肖像，身着剪裁完美的炭灰色西装和白衬衫，站在俯瞰现代城市天际线的大落地窗旁。表情冷静、自信。2. 创意总监：在充满微妙建筑形态的深色现代工作室中，身着精致的黑色高领毛衣，拍摄轻松的肖像，侧光戏剧化，具有高级的编辑氛围。3. 创始人：自然地坐在现代玻璃办公室的高级木质办公桌前，深色西装外套内搭简约衬衫。背景中有笔记本电脑和微妙的工作空间元素。表情平易近人且睿智。4. 电影感肖像：深邃建筑背景下的近景四分之三肖像，采用受控的轮廓光，阴影丰富，皮肤纹理真实，具有精致的奢侈品广告审美。5. 休闲专业人士：商务休闲装扮，穿着优雅的衬衫外套或高级针织衫，在黄金时刻的现代建筑旁进行户外拍摄。姿态自然，带有真诚而微妙的微笑。6. 演讲者：在现代演讲舞台上的动态环境肖像，背景是柔和模糊的礼堂灯光。主体自信地面对镜头，传达出权威感与沟通技能。7. 极简主义：极其干净的摄影棚肖像，身着单色服装，背景为米白色建筑。柔和的自然光，留白充裕，具有高端杂志审美。8. 标志性肖像：主视觉图像，主体自信地站在精致的深色渐变背景前，头发和肩膀周围有微妙的轮廓光，直视镜头，表情放松自信，具有奢华的个人品牌广告审美。视觉要求：• 每张照片必须具备真正不同的构图、环境、服装和情绪。• 在所有八张图像中保持完全一致的面部身份。• 呈现自然真实的皮肤毛孔和纹理。• 禁止塑料感皮肤、过度锐化、磨皮或美颜滤镜效果。• 在保持原有发型和胡须的基础上进行专业修饰。• 当手部可见时，确保手部和解剖结构真实。• 采用物理光照准确的精致电影感摄影。• 具备自然的景深和真实的镜头特性。• 呈现高端编辑级摄影效果，而非通用的企业库存照片。• 无 Logo、无水印、无随机文字、无物体畸变。排版设计：将 8 张照片以优雅的 2 × 4 编辑网格形式排列在干净的暖白色 A4 纸上。每张照片尺寸统一，间距充裕。添加极其微妙的细边框和极简的对齐标记。最终效果应类似于由专业创意机构制作的奢华个人品牌摄影样片，为拍摄对象提供八种完全不同的视觉形象，适用于网站、演讲者简介、社交媒体、新闻资料袋、作品集、商业演示、公司简介和个人品牌推广。照片级真实感，高端编辑级摄影，真实身份保留，精致构图，自然皮肤纹理，真实光影，细节极其丰富。

items.title: 个人资料 / 头像 - 电影感夜间车内人像
items.description: 一款专为弱光环境设计的专业人像提示词，捕捉豪华轿车后座的私密瞬间，呈现戏剧性的城市灯光效果。
items.prompt:
一张电影感、照片级真实感的特写人像，主体为 {argument name="subject description" default="一位坐在夜间车后座的年轻东亚女性"}。她留着一头自然顺滑、富有光泽的黑色长发，几缕发丝柔和地散落在脸颊旁，五官精致，皮肤纹理自然细腻，眼神深邃动人，画着淡雅的眼线，眉形自然柔和，唇色为低调的玫瑰红。她正视镜头，表情平静、中性，略带一丝忧郁。

{argument name="lighting style" default="温暖的金色横向路灯光带自然地掠过她的脸庞，营造出戏剧性的光影效果。"} 光线应柔和地照亮她的眼睛、鼻子、脸颊和嘴唇，同时让部分面部和头发隐入深邃的自然阴影中。保留真实的皮肤毛孔和细腻的面部细节，避免过度修图或产生塑料感。

她坐在深色豪华轿车内，周围是黑色真皮座椅和内饰。透过后窗可以看到夜间的城市景象，背景是高度模糊的绚丽灯光、温暖的黄色光斑、白色车头灯、隐约的红色交通灯以及深色的城市建筑。强烈的浅景深将她与背景完美分离。

使用专业的 {argument name="camera setting" default="全画幅相机，85mm 人像镜头，f/1.4 光圈"} 拍摄，电影级景深，真实的弱光摄影效果，柔和的胶片对比度，细腻的暖色高光，深邃的黑色调，自然的色彩分级，高动态范围，眼神锐利，发丝细节丰富，真实的皮肤纹理，柔和的虚化效果，营造出富有氛围感的夜间情绪。

构图：竖构图人像，主体位于画面中心略下方，展示头部和肩部，视角自然，亲密的特写取景，电影感的留白，前景呈现真实的汽车内饰框架。

超写实摄影，高细节，面部焦点清晰，保留自然瑕疵，真实光影，高端编辑摄影，电影剧照，细腻的胶片颗粒感，专业色彩分级，8K 分辨率，无人工美颜滤镜，无过度锐化，无面部畸变，无多余手指，无文字，无水印。

items.title: 个人资料 / 头像 - Woman with Guitar by Window Blinds
items.description: A photorealistic prompt for a cozy, slightly melancholic scene of a woman sitting by a window with an electric guitar, featuring dramatic blind-light shadows.
items.prompt:
Subject:
Guitar by the window in the afternoon

Subject Body:
A young adult woman sitting sideways on a dark wood counter by a window with wooden blinds. Position the person largely from the center to the right of the screen, featuring the face down to the bent legs and white socks, showing an electric guitar leaning in the right foreground and bottles and a biscuit jar at the bottom left.

Character/Expression:
Slightly thin oval face, bright smooth skin, grayish dark brown eyes, thin natural eyebrows, clean nose, and pale rose slightly parted lips. Facing the camera in front with an upward gaze and a quiet, listless expression. Long eyelashes, thin eyeliner, and faint redness under the eyes and on the cheeks. Long, messy wavy hair reaching near the waist, {argument name="hair color" default="near black"}, with bangs close to a center part and a large volume of hair surrounding the face and shoulders.

Clothing/Pose:
A short sleeveless top with thin shoulder straps made of white fine rib fabric with black trim, black shorts with a thick white waistband and trim, white calf-length loose socks, and a thin silver chain on the right wrist. Sitting sideways on the counter, with the left knee raised high and the right leg folded with the toes on the shelf below. Rest the left elbow on the raised knee, place the tip of the left finger on the lip, and let the right arm hang in front of the knee with the fingers loosely bent.

Background/Light:
Brown horizontal blinds occupying the top right, small music posters or cards on the white wall on the left. The bottom is a dark wood shelf, with a glass biscuit jar and a brown bottle on the left, an electric guitar with a wood-colored head and black neck in the right foreground, and a green bottle in the bottom right. Strong direct sunlight in thin strips enters from the window in the top right, diagonally illuminating the hair, shoulders, waist, and thighs. Soft fill light from the front ensures that the shadows on the face are not too heavy.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 2:3. Sitting portrait close to full body captured from a horizontal camera slightly lower than the seating surface, facing diagonally forward. Position the top of the head near the top edge and the tips of the white socks near the bottom edge, with the person large in the center and the guitar neck extending diagonally upward from the bottom right. Precision focus on the face, upper body, and raised left knee, with a medium depth of field where small items on the wall can be identified.

Texture/Style:
High-definition photorealistic live-action photo combining direct window light with a weak flash feel. Realistically depict the grain and luster of the skin, messy thin hair strands, rib fabric, sock weave, wood grain, glass, biscuits, and the metal and strings of the guitar. Slightly retro indoor colors based on white, black, and dark wood, avoiding excessive skin beautification or illustrative styles.

Negative:
Alteration of facial features, long messy hair, sitting posture, or guitar position

3. Bottom-left panel: two streetwear fashion subjects leaning against a wall, both wearing dark caps, sunglasses, oversized neutral jackets, dark baggy pants, and sneakers, each holding takeaway coffee. To their right, draw a large black ink sketch version of the same two people standing side by side in similar poses and outfits. Add small hearts, stars, and motion marks. Place one small rounded-corner inset photo thumbnail near the bottom left with a white border.
4. Bottom-right panel: one sporty woman standing on the left in a white crop top, loose white sweatpants, white sneakers, headphones, sunglasses, and a small black shoulder bag, looking down at a phone. Constraints: Exactly 4 panels, exactly 4 inset thumbnails total, exactly 5 real photographed people total across the collage, exactly 5 large sketched people total across the collage. items.title: 个人资料 / 头像 - Woman in Orchid Greenhouse Corridor
items.description: A surreal and beautiful photorealistic prompt featuring a woman in a mirrored greenhouse corridor filled with orchids, emphasizing reflections and floral density.
items.prompt:
Subject:
Flower corridor of orchids and mirrors

Subject Body:
A young adult woman standing in a mirrored greenhouse corridor with countless hanging orchids and greenery. Position the person's full body slightly left of the center of the screen, featuring the flowers, leaves, and long reflections of the legs repeated on the surroundings and the floor surface as the main subjects.

Character/Expression:
Small oval face, bright smooth skin, dark brown eyes, thin natural eyebrows, small nose, and pale coral lips. Facing the camera in front with a soft smile and mouth closed. Thin eyeliner, long eyelashes, and clean makeup with pale cheek color. Loose wavy dark brown hair down to below the chest, thin bangs trimmed above the eyebrows, and long hair strands flowing to both shoulders.

Clothing/Pose:
{argument name="top" default="White thin-strap top with a heart-shaped neckline and overlapping diagonal gathers"}, {argument name="skirt" default="pale beige mini skirt that fits the body"} with a small overlap on the right hem. Beige heel sandals with thin straps and a small beige bag on the left shoulder. Standing with legs almost together, holding the bag strap to the chest with the right hand, and lowering the left arm naturally. One foot placed slightly forward.

Background/Light:
Deep green orchid leaves and aerial roots covering the entire screen, with small white, pale pink, purple, and yellow flowers. The walls and floor on both sides are mirrors with visible seams, reflections continuing multiple times toward the center back, and thin silver handrails extending to the back right. Bright diffused light falls from the glass ceiling above and scattered white light sources, uniformly illuminating the person and the leaves. Shadows are very soft due to the reflected light from the mirrors.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 3:4. Long full-body portrait captured from a horizontal camera slightly lower than the chest, facing the front. Place the real image of the person in the top half near the center, and include large reflections of the flowers and inverted legs extending onto the mirror floor in the bottom half. Leave sufficient margins of dense flowers above the head and on the left and right. Deep depth of field where the person is in focus while details of the mirror corridor and flowers are also visible.

Texture/Style:
High-definition photorealistic live-action photo taken in bright greenhouse light. Realistic depiction of skin, hair, gathers of the white top, smooth skirt, leather bag, glossy leaves, flower petals, mirror seams, and clear reflections. Scatter deep greens with white and pastel flower colors, avoiding distortion of mirrored images or illustrative styles.

Negative:
Alteration of the person, costume, full-body reflection on the mirror floor, or flower density

items.prompt:
Subject:
{argument name="subject" default="Summer hair tied at the white sand beach"}

Main Character:
A young adult woman sitting sideways on a tropical beach with crystal-clear turquoise water and white sand, with her back to the camera. The figure is placed large in the center of the frame, highlighting her from head to toe, her {argument name="outfit" default="white ruffled swimsuit"}, raised arms, and {argument name="hairstyle" default="ponytail"}.

Person and Expression:
Bright, smooth skin, a small oval face, a neat nose, and pale pink lips. She is shown in a refined profile facing left, with eyes closed and a calm expression as if feeling the summer breeze. Her hair is light brown with thin bangs and delicate stray hairs, tied in a high, long ponytail. The hair bundle sways to the bottom right in the wind, with sunlight shining through the fine strands.

Clothing and Pose:
A pale ivory-white halter-neck swimsuit with delicate sheer chiffon ruffles under the bust and around the waist, and thin strings tied at the neck, back, and both sides of the hips. She sits sideways on the sand with her knees bent to the sides, back straightened and waist slightly twisted. Both arms are bent over her head, with the right hand holding the base of the ponytail and the left hand layered over the top of her head. Fine sand clings to the soles and toes of her feet.

Bleached thick driftwood and branches are in the foreground and background. Reflective light from the sea surface softly fills the shadow side.

3:4 vertical aspect ratio. A full-body portrait captured from a natural eye-level camera slightly above the sand surface, from a back-diagonal-right angle. The raised arms occupy the upper half, the back and waist in the center, and the bent legs and feet in the lower half, with a little blue sky margin left above the head. Precisely focused on the person, with the coast and driftwood softly blurred in a shallow to medium depth of field.

Texture and Style:
A high-definition photorealistic live-action photograph taken in strong summer sunlight. Realistically depicts natural skin texture, fine hair strands including backlighting, chiffon transparency and ruffles, thin strings, sand grains, the wet shoreline, and the dry texture of driftwood. Bright tropical colors of white, turquoise, and blue sky, avoiding excessive skin retouching or illustration styles.

Negative:
Alteration of sideways sitting, position of arms and hair, white swimsuit, or profile face.

items.title: 个人资料 / 头像 - Photorealistic Woman and Longhair Cat Scene
items.description: A highly detailed structured prompt for a photorealistic scene of a woman lifting a long-haired cat in the morning light.
items.prompt:
Subject: Hugging a cat by the window in the morning.

Main Subject: A {argument name="age group" default="20-something"} woman kneeling in a bedroom where the morning sun shines through white curtains, lifting a large long-haired cat horizontally. The cat's long body extends horizontally from the left to the right of the screen, crossing and hiding the woman's mouth and upper chest. Place the person and the cat prominently in the center of the screen.

Person/Expression: A small oval face visible above the cat's back, horizontal dark brown eyes, thin natural eyebrows, and pale pink cheeks. Face directed to the right of the screen, sending a gentle gaze toward the head of the cat being held. The mouth is hidden by the cat. Dark brown hair tied in a small bun high on the back of the head, leaving thin bangs and wisps along the cheeks.

Clothing/Pose: A thin-strap camisole top in {argument name="clothing color" default="ivory"} with a pale bluish-purple floral pattern, white lace trim at the chest, and a light blue ribbon in the center. Soft ivory shorts with a drawstring waist and fine ruffles at the hem, and short white socks. The person's left knee is on the floor, and the right knee is up with the right foot placed at the bottom right of the screen. The right arm is wrapped around the cat's front leg side, supporting near the shoulder with the right hand, and the left hand holds the abdomen from below.

Background/Light: The cat is a very large white longhair with {argument name="cat pattern" default="pale beige on the back and dark brown markings on the face and ears"}, blue eyes, and a thick tail. Head and front legs lowered to the right, hind legs and tail extended to the left. A large window with white lace curtains on the left, a wooden bed with white bedding on the right, and a wooden shelf with a small plant in the center background. Soft direct morning light enters through the window on the left, warmly illuminating the cat's fur, the person's arms and legs, and the wooden floor.

Composition/Camera: 6:7 aspect ratio. A full-body sitting portrait captured from a camera near the floor, slightly left of the front. The woman's face is in the upper left half, the cat's torso is placed large horizontally in the center, the raised right knee and white sock are in the lower right, and the left knee on the floor is in the lower left. The cat's tail and front legs extend close to the edges of the screen. Focus on the person's eyes and the cat's face and fur, with a shallow depth of field to softly blur the background.

Texture/Style: A high-definition photorealistic live-action photo taken in natural morning light. Naturally depict the long soft fur of the cat, skin, thin floral fabric, lace and ruffles, white bedding, and wooden floor, brightly coordinated in white and light wood tones.

Negative: Alteration of the cat's long horizontal posture and the support relationship of both hands.

items.title: 个人资料 / 头像 - Monotone Underground Parking Fashion
items.description: A photorealistic portrait of a young woman in a monotone outfit (white butterfly knit top and black denim) standing in a sterile underground parking garage.
items.prompt:
Subject:
Butterfly monotone in a parking lot

Main Character:
A young adult woman standing in the center of an aisle in a multi-story underground parking garage lined with fluorescent lights. The character's full body is placed large and straight in the center of the screen, with white minivans and black SUVs in the left and right background, concrete pillars, and ceiling piping shown as a nearly symmetrical background.

Character/Expression:
A small oval face, bright smooth skin, large dark brown eyes, thin well-groomed eyebrows, a small nose, and pale rose-colored lips. Facing the camera straight, with a quiet expressionless face and her head tilted slightly to the right of the screen. Thin black eyeliner, long eyelashes, pale pink cheeks. Long wavy hair nearly black reaching the waist, thin bangs parted near the center, long strands around the face and glossy hair falling from the shoulder to the left waist.

Clothing/Pose:
A white thin-strapped short-length ribbed knit top with a black butterfly and flower line drawing in the center, low-rise black washed denim shorts, a black belt, and a thin black strap along the hip bone. Short white socks and white platform lace-up sneakers. A small ivory bag with metal fittings and a chain on the right shoulder. Standing straight with legs together, right elbow bent with the right hand tucked by the hair at the ear, and the left arm down with fingers lightly curved.

Background/Light:
Gray concrete floor and low ceiling, exposed black piping, a horizontal row of white fluorescent lights, and pillars wrapped in yellow and black caution tape. A green '3rd Floor/Exit' guide on the central pillar, a white car in the back left, and a black car in the back right. Hard fluorescent lighting from above is the primary light source, with a weak front auxiliary light uniformly illuminating the skin and white clothing, casting a faint, outlined shadow at the feet. The back is dark but not crushed black.

Composition/Camera:
13:18 vertical aspect ratio. A full-body portrait captured head-on from a horizontal camera at chest height. Leaves space for the ceiling at the top, captures down to the platform shoes near the bottom edge, placing the person large in the center along the vertical lines of the pillars and the white lines on the floor. Cars on the left and right are placed at similar sizes in the middle ground. The face and full body are sharply focused, with a deep depth of field where the back of the parking lot is still visible.

Texture/Style:
A high-definition photorealistic live-action photo containing a slight sense of direct flash. Realistically depicts natural skin texture, fine strands of long hair, the ribbed knit and butterfly print, faded denim, metal fittings, platform shoes, coarse concrete, and reflections on the car body. Clearly shows black and white clothes against low-saturation gray, avoiding excessive skin smoothing or illustration styles.

Negative:
Modification of facial features, long hair, clothing, or standing pose.

Her torso is angled slightly away from the lens as she turns her head over one shoulder toward the camera, giving a calm, self-assured expression. Her long dark wavy hair is loose and moving naturally in the breeze, with fine flyaway strands catching the sunlight.

items.prompt:
Create an insanely lifelike, scroll-stopping portrait of a beautiful young adult {argument name="subject" default="East Asian woman"} in a {argument name="setting" default="warm minimalist interior"}, photographed at the fleeting moment she naturally turns her attention toward the camera.

Her features are delicate and balanced, with expressive dark almond-shaped eyes, sharp natural catchlights, softly defined brows, gently flushed cheeks, and naturally hydrated rosy-pink lips. Her straight jet-black hair is gathered into a neat low bun, with a few loose flyaway strands framing her face for an effortless, lived-in appearance.

She wears understated gold hoop earrings and an extremely fine gold necklace. An oversized cream-beige ribbed sweater sits naturally across her shoulders, slipping slightly from one side and revealing a simple black camisole strap underneath. One arm is relaxed behind her head, creating a candid, graceful silhouette rather than a deliberately posed fashion pose.

Her expression should carry the entire image: direct but gentle eye contact, relaxed confidence, a barely perceptible knowing smile, and the feeling that the camera captured her between moments. She should look effortlessly attractive without appearing aware of a photoshoot.

The setting is a quiet, cozy room with a smooth warm beige-cream wall. Frame vertically at 3:4 in a close-medium composition. Position her face around the upper-third area while leaving tasteful breathing room around her. The composition should feel spontaneous, intimate, elegant, and aesthetically addictive—the kind of image that looks like an unexpectedly perfect moment discovered on someone's camera roll.

items.description: A photorealistic prompt for a woman in a rainy neon city setting, featuring wet hair textures and flash-lit street photography aesthetics.
items.prompt:
Subject:
Rainy night neon in black attire

Main:
A close-up portrait of a single woman in her {argument name="age group" default="20s"} standing at a rainy downtown intersection. The subject is placed prominently in the center, featuring long wet hair, a {argument name="outfit" default="black fine-ribbed long-sleeve knit top"}, and red, blue, and white neon lights with wet road reflections in the background.

Character/Expression:
Slightly long oval face with smooth cheeks and a small round chin. Horizontal almond-shaped dark brown eyes with slightly upturned outer corners, thin low arched brows, a thin nasal bridge, and a small tip. The upper lip is thin, and the lower lip is thick with a glossy rose color. Facing the front with the chin slightly raised, quietly gazing just above the camera with lips slightly open. Wet glossy skin, light brown eye makeup, and a faint redness around the eyes and cheeks. Dark brown straight hair down to below the chest, with {argument name="hair condition" default="wet thin bangs and long strands"} clinging to the forehead, cheeks, and neck.

Clothing/Pose:
Black fine-ribbed long-sleeve knit top with a deep V-neck and slight sheerness, tied with a thin string at the lower chest to reveal the abdomen. Thin black shoulder straps visible underneath, with a thin black bag strap on the left shoulder. Standing with both shoulders facing forward, arms lowered off-screen. Tilted head slightly back to lengthen the neck.

Background/Light:
A large cylindrical building with pink numerical neon in the back left, surrounded by red, blue, and white vertical signs and large screens. In the middle ground are pedestrians with umbrellas, black cars, and a crosswalk. On the right is a dark lamppost covered in stickers. Red taillights and white lights reflect long on the wet road. Hard flash lighting from the front illuminates the face and chest, keeping the nighttime background dark while turning colored lights into round bokeh.

Composition/Camera:
3:4 aspect ratio. A close-up portrait from the chest down captured by a level camera at chest height. The face is centered in the upper half, with shoulders and chest filling the lower half; arms and abdomen are cut at the edges. The cylindrical building is placed in the upper left and the lamppost on the right. Precisely focused on the face and wet hair, with the background softly blurred by a shallow depth of field.

Texture/Style:
A high-definition photorealistic nocturnal street photo using direct flash. Realistically depicts wet skin and hair, sheer black knit, water film on the road, neon reflections, and raindrops, emphasizing red and blue light against a black base.

Negative:
Disappearance of wet hair and light glossy makeup.

Black fine-ribbed long-sleeve knit top with a deep V-neck and slight sheerness, tied with a thin string at the lower chest to reveal the abdomen. Thin black shoulder straps visible underneath, with a thin black bag strap on the left shoulder. Standing with both shoulders facing forward, arms lowered off-screen. Tilted head slightly back to lengthen the neck.

Background/Light:
A large cylindrical building with pink numerical neon in the back left, surrounded by red, blue, and white vertical signs and large screens. In the middle ground are pedestrians with umbrellas, black cars, and a crosswalk. On the right is a dark lamppost covered in stickers. Red taillights and white lights reflect long on the wet road. Hard flash lighting from the front illuminates the face and chest, keeping the nighttime background dark while turning colored lights into round bokeh.

Composition/Camera:
3:4 aspect ratio. A close-up portrait from the chest down captured by a level camera at chest height. The face is centered in the upper half, with shoulders and chest filling the lower half; arms and abdomen are cut at the edges. The cylindrical building is placed in the upper left and the lamppost on the right. Precisely focused on the face and wet hair, with the background softly blurred by a shallow depth of field.

Texture/Style:
A high-definition photorealistic nocturnal street photo using direct flash. Realistically depicts wet skin and hair, sheer black knit, water film on the road, neon reflections, and raindrops, emphasizing red and blue light against a black base.

She wears a {argument name="outfit" default="fitted black ribbed cotton scoop-neck crop tank"}, paired with a fine layered silver necklace and a small crystal-detailed crucifix pendant. Large minimalist silver hoop earrings complete the look.

The {argument name="setting" default="setting is an ordinary lived-in bedroom"} rather than a studio. Soft daylight enters from a nearby window on the left through translucent white curtains. A small white bedside table holds a leafy green houseplant. Behind her are naturally rumpled white bedsheets and a softly textured pale neutral wall.

Use realistic smartphone front-camera optics, slight natural lens distortion, imperfect exposure, subtle grain, authentic depth separation, and believable daylight. items.title: 个人资料 / 头像 - Woman Looking Out Garden Window
items.description: A detailed prompt for a high-definition photorealistic shot of a woman in lounge wear looking out a wooden window at a blooming garden.
items.prompt:
Subject: {argument name="theme" default="A window overlooking a flower garden"}

Subject details: A single adult woman in pale light blue loungewear by an open white wooden window. A portrait from head to mid-thigh, leaning her hands on the windowsill looking out at the garden and looking back over her shoulder in the center of the screen.

Character/Expression: A small oval face with a rounded chin, large dark brown almond-shaped eyes, thin natural eyebrows, a small nose, and pale pink lips. Facing over her right shoulder toward the upper right of the screen, looking up at the garden with a quiet profile and lips slightly parted. Dark brown chin-length bob with a center part, thin bangs, fine strands along the cheeks, and slightly wispy ends. Light eye makeup, pale blush, and skin warmed by natural light.

Outfit/Pose: {argument name="outfit" default="A light gray-blue fine-ribbed cropped camisole top with thin shoulder straps and matching fitted shorts"}. White trim and straps. Standing inside, leaning her torso deep toward the window from the waist, with arms extended and hands on the wooden windowsill. Back to the camera, with hips shifted to the left of the screen while looking back to the right.

Background/Light: {argument name="background" default="White wall on the left, sheer ecru lace curtains, a small wooden chest, and a white vase"}. Potted plant in a rattan basket at the bottom right, ecru bedding at the bottom edge. Outside the open window is a garden densely lined with purple, white, and pale pink flowers and green pots, a white deck chair, and a large ecru parasol. Warm, soft direct sunlight from the garden at the top right outlines the hair, shoulders, back, and hips, casting leaf shadows on the windowsill and indoors.

Composition/Camera: 3:4 aspect ratio. Shot from a horizontal perspective, slightly lower than the person's waist, diagonally from behind. The person is placed large from center to left, capturing head to mid-thigh, with the thigh cropped at the bottom edge. items.title: 社交媒体帖子 - Surreal Cloud Umbrella Path
items.description: A whimsical and surreal photography prompt for a woman holding a fluffy cloud like an umbrella under a bright blue summer sky.
items.prompt:
Subject:
{argument name="subject" default="Walking with a cloud umbrella under summer skies"}

Subject details:
A full-body shot of a woman holding a white cloud like an umbrella canopy under a vivid blue sky. The person stands small in the center of the lower half of the frame, making the vast sky and cloud the protagonists.

Character/Expression:
Dark brown straight shoulder-length hair parted to the side, with ends fluttering to the left in the wind. Profile view with brown eyes looking up at the high-held umbrella, a gentle expression with naturally closed lips. Slender build, bright natural skin, face rendered with modest detail appropriate for the distance.

Clothing/Pose:
{argument name="clothing" default="Light blue short-sleeved cropped blouse and a matching light flared mini skirt"}, with white strappy heel sandals. A cream-colored thin woven bag worn diagonally from the right shoulder. Standing at the edge of an embankment with legs lightly crossed, extending her right arm straight up to hold an umbrella with a thin black shaft and white curved handle. Left arm is relaxed at her side.

Background/Lighting:
{argument name="background" default="A clear deep blue sky occupying most of the frame"}. A single horizontal white cloud with cotton-like thickness and fine ridges floats above her head, with the black umbrella shaft connecting to its lower center. White cumulus clouds at lower levels, misty blue-green mountains, and blurred long grass in the foreground. Hard direct sunlight from the sun at the top right brightly illuminates the white clothes and cloud, creating distinct shadows.

Composition/Camera:
3:4 aspect ratio. A low-angle full-body shot with the camera placed near the ground looking up. The subject is slightly to the right of center, the cloud umbrella is in the top center, leaving wide blue sky negative space above and to the sides. The whole body and cloud are captured, with the diagonal embankment crossing the bottom. Focus on the person and the cloud; foreground grass is blurred. Natural compression of a medium telephoto lens.

Texture/Style:
High-definition photorealistic photo. Transparent summer colors, clean blue and white palette, soft hair and thin fabric in the wind, and the fluffy three-dimensional feel of the cloud. Refreshing and slightly fantastical, but the lighting on the person and scenery is realistic.

Negative:
Don't change the cloud umbrella to a normal fabric umbrella; don't use eye-level views or close-ups of the person.

items.title: 个人资料 / 头像 - Old Train Interior at Sunset
items.description: A detailed prompt for a cinematic photo of a woman in an old train car, looking out the window at sunset, capturing the nostalgic atmosphere of the golden hour.
items.prompt:
Subject:
{argument name="subject" default="Old train interior at sunset"}

Subject details:
{argument name="character details" default="A portrait of a single woman standing in the center of the frame by the window of an old train, looking outside while holding a vertical metal pole with her right hand. She is wearing a short cream-colored dress, a rattan bag, and other passengers and straps are visible in the background."}

Character/Expression:
Body almost facing forward, profile facing the window on the left, gaze set in the distance, a quiet, contemplative expression with closed lips. Smooth oval face with a small chin, long eyes visible from the side, natural eyebrows, thin bridge of the nose, and a rounded tip. Bright skin under the sunset with subtle makeup. Dark brown hair with thin bangs and wisps left on the cheeks, tied in a low ponytail at the back of the neck.

Clothing/Pose:
{argument name="clothing" default="Creamy white thin-strap dress"}. The chest is a deep V-shape with lace edges and diagonal fabric intersection, a wide elastic waist, a short thin-fabric flare skirt, and thin lace at the hem. A thin necklace and bracelet, and a brown open-work rattan bag on her right shoulder. She lightly grips the metal pole at chest height with her left hand, while her right arm is down by her side.

Background/Lighting:
On the left, a series of old metal-framed windows; silver vertical poles in the center and right; white triangular straps above. Several passengers line the seats in the back right. Low, harsh primary light from the setting sun shines through the left window, illuminating her face, neck, chest, and white dress in gold, while the depths of the car fall into deep amber shadows. Large dark blurs overlap the foreground on the left and right.

Composition/Camera:
3:4 portrait, eye-level, environmental portrait from head to mid-thigh. The subject occupies the center, with the window on the left and poles/passengers continuing into the depth on the right. Focus on the face, surrounded by foreground blur and shallow depth of field for a peeking effect.

Texture/Style:
Cinematic photorealistic photo. High-definition depiction of old metal, window glass, thin cotton, rattan, and skin, unified by golden sunset and deep brown shadows.

Negative:
Don't make the profile looking out the window face forward; don't omit background passengers or foreground blur.

items.prompt: 9:16 vertical orientation, ancient fantasy wuxia night scene female portrait, realistic and refined character poster style, high-precision Oriental fantasy beauty, {argument name="background atmosphere" default="bright, transparent, and dreamy night atmosphere"}. The main subject is a young adult East Asian woman, {argument name="visual age" default="approx. 20–28 years old"}, with exquisite delicate features, a soft oval face, natural and full mid-face, rounded almond eyes combined with elongated outer corners, clear and soft gaze, wearing a gentle smile, and possessing an atmosphere that is dreamy, agile, noble, bright, and magnificent. Her skin is fair and delicate with a transparent glow. Her makeup is peach-pink watery glaze style, elegant and sophisticated, with delicate eye makeup and soft moist lip makeup. Natural highlights are present on the tip of the nose, under the eyes, on the cheekbones, and the Cupid's bow, appearing styled but not cloying. Her hair is smooth black long hair, partially loose and partially tied back, voluminous and smooth, with a fluffy and exquisite top styling. Her headpiece is a heavy-duty ancient style crown featuring silver-white metal, pearl tassels, light purple gemstones, crystal floral ornaments, and fine chain pendants, ornate and complex but not overwhelming the face. Her earrings are exquisite long-drop pearls and light purple crystal earrings with distinct fine highlights. Her attire is a high-waisted fantasy dress with a chest wrap and pearl-chain overlay, in a {argument name="costume color" default="light purple and silver-white palette"}, primarily light misty purple, pearl white, and silver-white, accented with cold silver, light purple crystals, and pearl embellishments. The upper bodice is exquisitely structured, covered with a dense pearl-chain layer over the chest and neck. The skirt consists of multiple layers of light gauze, semi-transparent outer gauze, delicate silver-thread embroidery, and crystal droplets, overall high in luxury, light, agile, and ethereal. The fabric has delicate soft bright reflections and shimmering textures under the lamplight. The character stands in front of a staircase of layered colored-glaze lamps, presented from a front-leaning three-quarter perspective, with her body slightly angled toward the camera and her head naturally turned to face it, with a shallow smile. One hand elegantly holds an exquisite small colored-glaze lantern, which has a transparent cover and metal handle, with bright and soft warm white candlelight inside. The other hand hangs naturally or lightly touches the side of her skirt, with movements that are soft and natural, not exaggeratedly posed. The shot is a medium-upper body close-up, focusing on the face, makeup, headpiece, upper attire, and the interaction between the lantern and the character. The background consists of ancient-style balconies and long staircases lit by layers of lamps, with gold-topped pavilions, flying eaves, night towers, and layered seas of lanterns visible in the distance. Both sides of the lantern stairs are filled with warm white lanterns and fine points of light, mixed with a few light purple flower trees and soft purple-gold bokeh. The overall background is dreamy and bright with depth and layering, but not overly blurred, allowing the contours of the lantern stairs, balconies, and night architecture to be seen. The night sky is deep blue, and the overall night scene should be bright, clean, and dreamy, not dark or muddy. The lighting is a mix of warm lamplight and soft facial fill light, with the face lit delicately and brightly, clear features, and spirited eyes. Fine shimmering highlights are created on the headpiece, earrings, pearl-chain overlay, lantern, and clothing embroidery. A slight rim light outlines the hair edges and shoulder contours. The overall image requires high precision, high completeness, a realistic refined feel, a clear character subject, and no obvious motion blur, presenting a magnificent atmosphere of a female lead in an ancient fantasy night scene looking back.

items.description: A cinematic high-angle prompt depicting a woman reaching her hand towards the camera against a vibrant, bokeh-filled neon street background.
items.prompt:
Subject:
Hand reaching towards the neon lights

Primary Subject:
A vertical wide-angle photo of a single woman in the lower right corner, leaning forward and reaching her right hand out significantly toward the camera beside a {argument name="location" default="downtown pedestrian bridge"}. She is wearing {argument name="clothing color" default="pink"} ruffled clothes, in a pose with one leg raised behind her, against a night road with cars and glowing signs.

Character/Expression:
The upper body and head lean heavily to the left of the frame, with {argument name="eye color" default="brown"} eyes looking up toward the camera, and glossy pink lips lightly closed in a serious yet soft expression. A small oval face with a rounded chin, large almond-shaped eyes, thin parallel eyebrows, and a small, well-shaped nose. Eyeliner extending from the outer corners of the eyes with pink lower eyelids and bright glossy skin. Long light-brown hair with thin bangs and large waves flowing over the left shoulder.

Clothing/Pose:
A short camisole top with a light pink floral pattern, thin shoulder straps, lace trim, and a ribbon tie at the chest. A pink belt and a short pleated skirt layered with sheer plaid fabric, lace, and ruffles. White high socks and white/pink platform sneakers. A pink shoulder bag with a small stuffed animal charm. She is holding a black handrail with her left hand, standing on her left leg with her right knee bent back and shoe raised to the lower left, extending her right arm toward the camera at the upper right of the frame.

Background/Lighting:
A large night street with cars lined up from the left to the center background, colorful vertical signs and window lights on both sides, and a single man standing in the right middle ground. In addition to the diffused light from streetlamps and signs, a soft white light source on the camera side brightly illuminates the face and torso. The background consists of blue dusk and warm-colored bokeh.

Composition/Camera:
3:4 vertical orientation, a wide-angle portrait with a strong high-angle view looking down at the subject. The person occupies a large portion from the bottom right to the center, with the extended right hand appearing extremely large in the upper right foreground, while the head and torso recede and appear smaller. The entire figure from head to the raised shoe is within the frame, with focus on the face and a slight blur on the hand and night scenery.

Texture/Style:
A photorealistic live-action photo with a flash feel. High-definition rendering of lace, transparent ruffles, metal charms, skin, road surface, and neon reflections, with a strong contrast between pink and the blue night.

Negative:
Do not make the foreground right hand small; do not lower the right leg raised behind.

items.title: 个人资料 / 头像 - Reaching Hand in Summer Park
items.description: A prompt for a wide-angle, low-angle portrait of a woman reaching her hand towards the camera in a lush green park under a bright summer sky.
items.prompt:
Subject: Hand reaching toward the summer sky

Main: {argument name="scene" default="A vertical full-body-leaning photo of a single woman in a sunny park, reaching her left hand out greatly toward the camera"}. {argument name="clothing" default="A short peach-colored dress with a small floral pattern"}, with the palm in the immediate foreground, blue sky, and trees as main elements.

Character/Expression: Leaning forward slightly, face facing forward, brown eyes looking at the camera with lips slightly parted. Small oval face with a thin chin, slightly slanted almond eyes, thin parallel brows, straight nose, and glossy pale pink lips. Bright skin with pink blush and thin eyeliner lifting the corners of the eyes. Long brown hair with thin bangs and large waves flowing to the right side of the chest.

Background/Light: Green grass at the bottom, dark green trees on the sides and center-back, and a vivid blue sky with few clouds in the upper half. Hard direct sunlight from the upper left creates starburst rays and lens flares, brightly rimming the hair and shoulders.

Composition/Camera: 3:4 portrait, low-angle view looking up from near the ground. The subject occupies most of the center, showing from head to below the thighs. The extended left hand is extremely large in the lower-left foreground, creating a wide-angle perspective where the face and torso appear smaller in the distance. Focus on the face, with the hand slightly blurred.

Texture/Style: Vivid photorealistic live-action photo. High-definition expression of skin, thin floral fabric, lace, translucent nails, grass, and sunlight filtering through trees.

Negative: Do not make the hand in front small; do not change the shape of the lace-up dress.

items.rawText:
Goal: Create a realistic dark-mode social media post screenshot about a leaked AI image model, styled like an X/Twitter post.

Canvas: Square 1024×1024 image, black background, with a single tweet occupying the full frame. Use authentic X/Twitter dark mode spacing, white text, blue hashtag/link color, and slightly rounded embedded media corners.

Tweet header: Top left circular profile photo of a light-skinned middle-aged man in a white shirt. Display name is {argument name="display name" default="White"} in bold white text with a blue verified checkmark, and handle {argument name="username" default="@White1637402"} in gray beneath or beside it. Top right has two small UI icons: a stylized X/Twitter action icon and a three-dot menu.

Tweet text: Use the exact visible post copy: “A new GPT image model just appeared on Arena called mona-lisa-1. It's extremely better than Image 2. 💪💪” followed by a blank line and the blue hashtag {argument name="hashtag" default="#ChatGPT"}. Keep line breaks and spacing like a real tweet.

Embedded media layout: Below the tweet text, show exactly 2 side-by-side image cards in one row, separated by a thin black gutter, both with rounded outer corners.

Left media card: A glossy 3D illustration of a cute white-and-black robot mascot in a classroom or chalkboard setting, waving with its right hand and holding a paper sign. The robot has a rounded black face screen with two glowing cyan smiling eyes, white helmet-like head shell, white body panels, black joints, and a friendly pose. Behind it is a chalkboard covered with handwritten educational text and doodles. Large chalk text reads “Hi there! I’m ChatGPT” on the left, and “That’s me!” with an arrow pointing toward an OpenAI swirl logo on the upper right. The robot’s paper sign reads “I was created by OpenAI” with smaller text underneath. Add realistic 3D lighting, slight depth of field, and toy-like materials.

Right media card: A dramatic cinematic poster-like fantasy/business scene showing exactly 3 human figures: two giant suited men looming in the stormy cloudy sky above, and one small caped figure seen from behind in the foreground. The two giant men resemble tech executives, wearing dark business suits and looking down sternly; one has glasses and gray hair, the other has curly hair. The foreground figure wears a bright royal-blue cape with a white logo and the word “claeposeok” or similarly misspelled text on the back, standing on rocky ground and holding a sword at their side. The sky is dark, smoky, and epic with strong rim lighting, blue-gray clouds, and heroic scale.

Visible text count: Include exactly 7 main visible text groups: 1 display name “White”, 2 handle “@White1637402”, 3 tweet body sentence, 4 hashtag “#ChatGPT”, 5 chalkboard phrase “Hi there! I’m ChatGPT”, 6 chalkboard phrase “That’s me!”, 7 paper sign “I was created by OpenAI”. Minor chalk scribbles may be present but should be small and not dominant.

Visual style: Photorealistic screenshot compositing with crisp UI text, realistic embedded image thumbnails, high contrast, and no extra watermark. Keep the overall look like a viral tech leak tweet screenshot discussing {argument name="model name" default="mona-lisa-1"}.

She has very long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="platinum white"} hair with soft windblown strands, large sparkling blue eyes, fair skin, a blush, and an open smiling expression. Vertical portrait composition, 2:3 aspect ratio, no text, no watermark, no extra characters.

items.title: 个人资料 / 头像 - Sunlight and Water Ripple Portrait
items.description: A poetic and highly detailed prompt for generating a high-definition realistic photograph of a woman standing in a forest stream, featuring intricate lighting and water effects.
items.prompt:
Subject:
{argument name="subject" default="Dance of Water in dappled sunlight"}

Primary Figure:
A vertical full-body photograph of a single woman standing on one leg in a shallow stream within a deep green forest. Water droplets fall from her long pale beige dress, creating circular ripples at her feet.

Person/Expression:
Face slightly turned toward the lower left of the frame, with downcast eyes and a quiet expression with closed lips. Small oval face with a slender chin, downward-slanting almond-shaped eyes, thin gentle eyebrows, a straight nose bridge, and pale coral lips. Fair skin with subtle makeup. Long light brown hair parted in the middle, flowing in soft waves over her back and shoulders.

Clothing/Pose:
A pale greige halter-neck dress. The neckline is a deep V, with fabric crossing in front of the torso, flowing from the waist into layered sheer ruffles and a long asymmetrical hem. Both arms are bent overhead with hands resting on the back of the head; she stands on her right leg with the left leg bent at the knee, resting against the right leg.

Background/Lighting:
The entire background consists of dark green leaves and a deep forest, while the bottom of the frame shows a transparent shallow stream with reflections. Soft, dappled sunlight from above illuminates her hair, shoulders, dress, and legs, while the surroundings fall into deep shadow. Water droplets and ripples glisten in the backlight.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 3:4 portrait, viewed almost horizontally from near the low water surface. The person is framed centrally from head to toe, with the ripples at her feet placed near the bottom edge. Focus is on the person and the water droplets, with the background leaves softly blurred by a shallow depth of field.

Texture/Style:
High-definition photorealistic live-action photograph. Delicately depicts semi-transparent wet fabric, water droplets, skin, and a quiet water surface, cinematically contrasting the deep green with warm dappled sunlight.

Negative:
Change of one-legged standing pose; do not omit the long asymmetrical hem of the dress.

items.prompt: 9:16 portrait orientation, high-precision ancient Chinese xianxia style portrait of a cool and aloof female lead, Oriental fantasy period costume refined portrait, realistic character photography texture, snow-covered eave corridor scene, cold white ice and snow atmosphere. The overall tone is cold, detached, quiet, restrained, and ethereal, but the character's mental state is clear and spirited, not sickly or weak. The main subject is a young adult Oriental female, visual age approx. 20-28, with clear Oriental female features. She has delicate and smooth facial bone structure, a small and narrow oval face, clean facial contours, slender almond eyes with a quiet, clear, and slightly distant gaze, a delicate natural nose bridge, and soft, fine lips. The character's profile is towards an ice bell, gaze focused and calm, expression light but spirited, not smiling, and without sad or sickly expressions. Makeup is a cold white moonlight look, with an immortal-like intensity. Base is cold white, transparent, thin, and delicate, retaining natural skin texture and soft luster. Eye makeup uses cool gray-brown, light gray-pink, extremely light ice-blue gray, and a small amount of silver-white pearlescent for detailed blending, emphasizing the slender eyes; thin natural eyeliner extending slightly; long, distinct lashes. Fine cold white highlights on the nose bridge, tip, under-eyes, and cheekbones, like snow reflections on the face. The top structure is exquisite but not too high, with a small amount of soft stray hairs on the sides to frame the face. The headwear is ornate, using a combination of cool silver crowns, ice crystal flowers, transparent crystals, white jade, light blue gems, and long silver chain tassels, ornate but cold and restrained. Paired with exquisite silver-white long hanging earrings echoing the ice bell material. Clothing is a moon-white, ice-blue, and silver cross-collared ancient style robe + gauze cloak-style outer layer, medium-high gorgeousness. Main colors are moon white, ice blue, cold white; secondary colors are light silver, misty blue-gray, accented with cold silver, ice crystals, and white jade. Fabrics use soft silk feel, fine embroidered gauze, translucent gauze, and light layered materials. The lapels, cuffs, and shoulders have ice flower, snow, and cloud patterns with fine silver thread embroidery. The character's figure is naturally full, upper body proportions coordinated, breasts naturally full, fully supported and covered by the clothing, no exposure, no vulgar sexual expression. The cross-collared lapel position is slightly lower than traditional high collars, forming an elegant and natural open neckline, clearly revealing the complete collarbone, neck, and shoulder lines, and the upper chest area, with only a small amount of natural cleavage line visible; fabric still stably covers the main chest, no deep V exposure. Natural full curves are expressed through fitting but not tight overlapping lapels, waist cinching, and three-dimensional tailoring of the upper body. The character stands under the eaves of a snow-covered ancient corridor. The shot is a close-up from the front-side, composition from bust to upper body. The body is slightly turned towards the camera, head turned towards an ice bell hanging under the eave, one hand elegantly raised with fingertips lightly approaching or touching the ice crystal pendant, movement light and natural, fingers relaxed, no exaggerated posing. Multiple sets of transparent ice crystal bells, silver small bells, long ice crystal pendants, and fine chains hang under the eaves, producing fine transparent highlights when hit by cold light. The foreground shows dark wooden eaves and carved beams, creating light-dark contrast between the cold white character and dark wooden architecture. Background is a snow-covered courtyard, ancient building eaves, snow trees, and winter corridor space, using shallow depth of field for soft blurring, but retaining clear Oriental classical architectural outlines. The background snow is bright and clean, no dirty snow, mud, gray mist, or dilapidated buildings. Lighting is cold white reflected light from snow + soft side-backlight. Snow reflection provides bright soft cold white fill light for the face, collarbone, and lapels. Side-backlight outlines the black hair, hair ornaments, shoulder gauze, and ice bell edges, forming clear and clean hair rim lighting. Dark parts remain transparent with details, skin tone not greenish or grayish, the whole image cold but not gray, bright but not overexposed. Photography language is high-quality ancient style real-life portrait, 85mm-105mm portrait lens feel, close-range half-body photography, shallow depth of field, natural perspective, high-precision facial features, real skin texture, real hair, real embroidery and transparent gauze texture, realistic ice crystal refraction, high-end refined but not over-smoothed. Overall presentation: Snow eaves ice bells x Cold white moonlight makeup x Moon white ice blue immortal dress x Cold aloof Oriental female lead x Collarbone and natural upper chest lines x Bright pure winter xianxia portrait.

items.title: 个人资料 / 头像 - University Classroom Fashion Portrait
items.description: An editorial photography prompt for a woman in a modern university classroom, featuring sophisticated styling and soft window light.
items.prompt:
Create an ultra-photorealistic cinematic editorial photograph of a {argument name="subject" default="beautiful young adult Filipino-Korean woman in her early 20s"} inside a {argument name="setting" default="completely empty modern classroom"}. The classroom has rows of wooden desks and chairs, a large green chalkboard, tall windows, subtle academic details, and a clean, slightly nostalgic university atmosphere.

She has refined Filipino-Korean facial features, clear natural skin, expressive dark-brown eyes, and long, silky dark-brown hair with soft natural waves and delicate face-framing strands.

She wears an attractive sophisticated campus-inspired outfit: a {argument name="outfit" default="fitted cream knit top layered beneath a tailored dark-brown blazer, paired with a high-waisted pleated midi skirt and elegant loafers"}. items.prompt:
Subject:
{argument name="theme" default="White flowers held up toward backlighting"}

Main Subject:
{argument name="scene" default="An above-the-waist portrait of a young woman in a white sheer tube top holding a bundle of small white flowers to the top left in a dark, stone-like interior. Person/Expression:
Small oval face turned toward the top left of the screen, chin raised significantly, looking at the flowers with light brown eyes. Thin eyebrows, small nose, and a quiet profile with light coral lips slightly open. Light brown hair down to below the shoulders has thin bangs, with thin strands of hair floating to the right of the screen, edged in gold by the backlighting.

Clothing/Pose:
White semi-transparent strapless short top. Fastened at the top of the chest with fine elastic gathers, with very thin fabric layered twice to spread as large waving ruffles below the chest. A small amount of matching gathered waist is visible at the bottom. Stretching the person's own right arm to the top left of the screen, holding a small bunch of white flowers with thin stems with the fingertips. The other arm is hidden behind the body, slightly arching the upper body.

Background/Light:
Background is high dark-gray walls and pillars, with two slender arched windows shining white side-by-side at the bottom of the screen. Hard white backlighting shines from directly behind the top of the head, brightly edging the hair, shoulders, sheer cloth, and flowers. Numerous fine dust particles and several transparent bubbles float in the air, catching the light.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 3:4. An above-the-waist image capturing from the flower bundle in the top left to mid-waist with a very strong low angle placing the camera lower than the waist. The person is photographed large across almost the entire height of the screen, with the hand and flowers in the top-left foreground, the face in the top third, the white ruffles in the center, and the abdomen in the bottom half. Focus on the face and flowers, and softly blur the dark walls.

Texture/Style:
High-definition photorealistic photo based on deep dark-gray, white, warm skin tones, and golden backlighting. Delicately depicts sheer wrinkled cloth, rim lighting on hair, white flowers, dust and bubbles in the air, and strong light-dark contrast.

Negative:
{argument name="negative instructions" default="do not weaken the white flowers held to the top left and the strong low angle; do not change the backlighting behind the head to front lighting"}

items.title: 个人资料 / 头像 - Ultra-Realistic Underwater Selfie Portrait
items.description: A complex prompt for a high-quality underwater selfie featuring an East Asian woman with water caustics and realistic floating hair.
items.prompt:
Based on the image in Figure 1, generate a hyper-realistic underwater photograph of a {argument name="person" default="young East Asian woman"} who has just entered a clear shallow pool. The body is fully submerged in an {argument name="shooting distance" default="ultra-close-up"} underwater selfie portrait. The subject faces the camera, with the face centered and occupying the main visual area. The lens is about 30–50 cm from the face with a slight wide-angle selfie perspective, capturing the head, shoulders, and upper body.

The woman has a natural soft oval face, fair skin, and medium-length black hair spreading out in the water, floating slowly due to buoyancy. She wears round thin-framed glasses, her eyes are naturally open looking at the camera, and she has a gentle smile showing teeth. Her expression is relaxed, calm, and tender, without any sense of holding breath or tension.

She is wearing a {argument name="clothing" default="light cream-colored off-the-shoulder knit top"}. The fabric clings naturally to her body and floats slightly in the water. Her arms are extended toward the camera in a close-up selfie composition, with a natural wide-angle perspective on the foreground arm.

The camera is fully underwater, slightly below the surface, where the undulating water surface and mirror reflections are visible above her head. Clear light blue pool water with a simple background. A few small bubbles rise slowly around her, creating the moment of just entering the water without large violent bubbles.

Bright natural sunlight shines from above, refracting through the water to form dynamic underwater caustics on her forehead, cheeks, glasses, shoulders, and clothing. Highlights are natural golden-white, and the water is transparent cyan-blue. Soft facial exposure with natural shadows and realistic skin texture.

items.prompt:
Subject:
Spring eyes through cherry blossoms

Main Subject:
A close-up portrait of a young woman in {argument name="outfit" default="white lace clothing"} looking up toward the light, with pale cherry blossoms in the foreground. The person's face and shoulders are positioned largely from the center to the right of the frame, overlapping with flowers at the top, hair translucent in backlighting, and a wooden background.

Character/Expression:
Has a gentle oval face and a small rounded chin, facing the upper left of the screen. Large {argument name="eye color" default="amber-brown"} almond-shaped eyes gazing upward, thin straight-ish eyebrows, a thin bridge and rounded tip of the nose, and slightly parted pink glossy lips with a thinner upper lip and fuller lower lip. Fair skin with pale pink around the eyes and cheeks. Long dark brown hair with thin bangs and fine strands around the face, blowing to the left in the wind.

Clothing/Pose:
A white floral lace top with translucent short ruffled sleeves. A thin lace edge follows the deep V-neckline. Pulling the shoulder slightly to the left and extending the neck while turning only the face toward the light.

Background/Lighting:
Clusters of pale pink cherry blossoms and green leaves in the upper foreground, with a largely blurred wooden pillar and crossbar from background left to center, and blue sky visible through a window. Warm, direct-ish backlighting from the top left illuminates the cheeks, nose, and shoulders, fringing each strand of hair in gold.

Composition/Camera:
3:4 vertical aspect ratio. The camera is at a horizontal eye level with the shoulders, capturing a close-up from the top of the head to the chest. The face is placed large in the upper half of the center, with the right ear and back of the head cropped at the right edge, and cherry blossoms layered shallowly on the top edge. Focused on the {argument name="focus point" default="closer eye"}, with the flowers and wooden background heavily blurred.

Texture/Style:
A high-definition photorealistic photo utilizing warm spring backlighting. Realistic depiction of natural skin texture, wet-looking glossy lips, translucent lace, thin hair strands, soft petals, and light reflections.

Negative:
Drastic changes to facial features; excessive makeup

items.title: 个人资料 / 头像 - Summer Poolside Reflection Portrait
items.description: A professional-grade photorealistic prompt for generating a summer portrait of a woman looking over her shoulder in an outdoor pool, featuring wet textures, sunlit water reflections, and a white one-piece swimsuit.
items.prompt:
Subject:
Summer pool portrait

Subject details:
A realistic portrait of a woman in her 20s in the shallow water of an outdoor pool, captured from behind. She is wearing a {argument name="clothing" default="white one-piece swimsuit"} and looking back over her shoulder near the pool's metal ladder, twisting her body slightly. Fine water droplets remain on her skin and hair, and the reflections from the blue water surface illuminate the surroundings brightly.

Person/Expression:
The face is directed toward the camera over the shoulder with a {argument name="expression" default="calm and soft gaze"}. Small oval face, clean jawline, slightly large almond-shaped eyes, natural thin eyebrows, small nose, and pale pink glossy lips. Light brown eye makeup with a natural flush and transparent wet skin. Dark brown hair tied in a loose updo, with thin bangs and a few wet strands left around the face.

Clothing/Pose:
A simple white one-piece swimsuit. The back is wide open with thin straps crossing near the center of the back. There are cutouts near the waist, and the wet fabric naturally follows the contours of the skin. The body is diagonal to the pool edge, {argument name="setting" default="in a kneeling posture in the water"}. The upper body is slightly twisted, pulling one shoulder back to look around. One arm is in the water by the side of the body, maintaining a natural balance and posture.

Background/Light:
The background is an outdoor pool bordered by white tiles and a bright deck. A shiny stainless steel pool ladder is on the right side of the frame. The water is a vibrant blue with fine ripples and strong reflections. Natural sunlight from a clear sky shines from diagonally above, creating bright highlights on the hair, shoulders, and back. Soft shadows from tree shade fall in the background, providing a refreshing summer daytime feel.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 3:4 aspect ratio. A close-up portrait from the waist to the thighs, with the person positioned prominently in the center to slightly left of the frame. The camera position is slightly higher than behind the person, an angle where the face is clearly visible over the shoulder. The ladder on the right adds depth, and the background is lightly blurred. Clear focus on the person's eyes and face, with natural shallow depth of field for the water and background.

Texture/Style:
High-resolution realistic photographic expression. Detailed depiction of wet hair, transparent water droplets, damp swimsuit fabric, natural skin texture, and the reflection of the metal ladder. Avoid excessive HDR or strong filters, emphasizing the contrast between natural skin tones and the blue water surface. A fresh and clean color tone suited for summer sunlight.

Negative:
Excessive makeup; unnatural body deformation or limbs; collapsed swimsuit strap structure.

items.description: A detailed technical prompt for a close-up portrait of a woman with black hair leaning against her shoulder in a dark room lit only by warm candlelight.
items.prompt:
Subject:
{argument name="theme" default="Black hair sinking into the light"}

Main Subject:
In a dark room lit only by the warm light of a candle, a chest-up close-up of a {argument name="person" default="young woman"} wearing a {argument name="outfit" default="white thin-strap top"}, leaning her cheek against her raised shoulder in the foreground. The face is placed large in the center of the frame, showing the rounded shoulder in the left foreground, black hair crossing the face, and the light in the back left.

Person/Expression:
A rounded oval face with a small chin, tilting the face to the left and pressing the cheek against her own shoulder. Dark brown elongated eyes, slightly thick linear eyebrows, thin bridge of the nose and small round tip, thin upper lip and thick lower lip with a glossy dull pink color. A quiet expression with lips slightly parted, looking straight ahead. Bright semi-matte skin with modest blush and thin eyeliner. Straight black hair down to below the chest is parted near the center, with long bangs and several strands crossing the eyes, bridge of the nose, and cheeks diagonally.

Clothing/Pose:
A warm white thin-strap ribbed top. Shallow round neck, fine vertical ridges, form-fitting. Twisting the body to the right and leaning forward, raising her own right shoulder high into the left foreground. Peeking her face from behind her shoulder and resting her right cheek and near her lips against the shoulder. The arm extends diagonally to the bottom of the screen and is cut off.

Background/Light:
The background is a dark brown bedroom, with a small table lamp or the orange flame of a candle in the back left, a vertical curtain at the top right, and brown bedding at the bottom left. Hard warm light from the left front illuminates the eyes, nose, lips, and shoulders, sinking the hair and background into deep shadows.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 3:4. The camera is at a horizontal perspective at the same height as the face, capturing a chest-up close-up from the top of the head to below the chest. The face is placed large in the center of the upper half, with the rounded shoulder overlapping from the bottom left to the center as a strong foreground, and the right chest and strap cut off at the edge. Sharp focus on both eyes and lips, with the candle light softly blurred.

Texture/Style:
High-definition photorealistic photo based on deep black, dark brown, amber, and warm white. Realistically depicts fine skin, wet-looking lips, glossy black hair, ribbed fabric, and warm shadows.

Negative:
Do not separate the close-up composition where the cheek and the foreground shoulder overlap

items.title: 个人资料 / 头像 - Eight Distinct Studio Portraits Grid
items.description: Generates a photorealistic 4-by-2 grid of eight similar-styled but visibly distinct studio headshots for face variation comparison.
items.prompt:
Goal: Create a photorealistic comparison grid of eight distinct young East Asian women’s ID-style headshots, emphasizing clearly different facial features while keeping the same general styling.

Canvas: Wide horizontal image in a 16:9 aspect ratio, clean white studio background, divided into exactly 8 equal portrait panels arranged in a 4-column by 2-row grid. Use thin light-gray divider lines between panels, no text, no logos, no watermark.

Subject details: Show exactly 8 separate head-and-shoulders portraits, each facing directly forward and looking into the camera with a calm neutral expression. All are young adult East Asian women with fair skin, long dark brown to black wavy hair, soft see-through bangs, natural makeup, a white knit sweater, and a delicate small necklace. Make each face visibly unique: 1) oval face with balanced eyes and soft lips, 2) slightly rounder face with wider eyes and gentler cheeks, 3) narrower face with straighter brows and smaller mouth, 4) brighter wide-eyed face with slightly shorter bangs, 5) longer face with heavier waves and more serious gaze, 6) petite heart-shaped face with softer jaw and subtle pout, 7) round face with fuller cheeks and larger eyes, 8) slim face with longer hair framing the cheeks and a composed expression.

Visual style: High-resolution realistic studio photography, soft even front lighting, minimal shadows, natural skin texture, clean beauty portrait retouching, sharp focus on eyes, subtle hair detail, consistent camera distance and crop across all panels.

Customizable elements: Use {argument name="number of portraits" default="8"} portraits in a {argument name="grid layout" default="4 columns by 2 rows"} grid, featuring {argument name="subject type" default="young East Asian women"} with {argument name="hairstyle" default="long dark wavy hair with see-through bangs"} wearing {argument name="outfit" default="white knit sweaters with delicate small necklaces"}.

Constraints: Do not make the faces identical; each portrait must have a distinct face shape, eye shape, brow style, nose, mouth, and overall facial balance. Keep the clothing, background, lighting, and pose consistent so the facial differences are the main comparison point.

items.title: 个人资料 / 头像 - Tang Dynasty Spice Shop Night Portrait
items.description: A cinematic prompt for creating a nostalgic atmosphere of a Tang Dynasty spice shop at night, featuring a female shop owner glancing back from a doorway with warm lantern lighting and a boyfriend's perspective.
items.prompt:
Theme:
{argument name="theme" default="Glancing back outside a Tang Dynasty West Market spice shop after closing"}

Subject:
Vertical 2:3. Nighttime at the West Market in Chang'an during the Tang Dynasty, a foreign merchant's spice shop has just closed. The wooden door is half-ajar, with warm-colored lanterns under the eaves and moonlight both illuminating the character. Only one adult woman appears; the boyfriend does not appear in the frame.

Character/Expression:
The main character in the attached image is translated as a {argument name="role identity" default="Tang Dynasty spice shop proprietress"}, a mature woman in her twenties. Her black hair is half-up, adorned with a light gold hairpin and pearl earrings. She wears {argument name="outfit" default="an apricot-white chest-high ruqun and a light gold embroidered sheer silk shawl"}, with a sachet at her waist. Her cheeks are slightly flushed; hearing her boyfriend call her from outside the door, she turns her body back with a hint of surprise and shyness at the corner of her mouth.

Clothing/Pose:
Apricot-white chest-high ruqun, light gold embroidered sheer silk shawl, sachet hanging from the waist. The character turns sideways and looks back, one hand lightly touching the door frame, the other naturally holding the shawl. The movement captures only the moment of looking back, without stacking a second gesture.

Boyfriend Perspective/Shot:
The boyfriend stands about two steps outside the door, recording in the first person with a camera or phone. The frame retains a very subtle edge of the boyfriend's hem or the door frame in the foreground. The camera position is slightly below eye level, close enough to feel like a candid frame taken after a date at the shop. It is not a voyeuristic shot, not a commercial studio shot, and not a staged advertisement.

Background/Lighting:
Night street scene of the Tang Dynasty West Market, a mix of warm lanterns under the eaves and moonlight. Blurred silhouettes of horses, lanterns, and pedestrians are along the street. The warm lanterns are the primary light, with moonlight as auxiliary; continuous soft light is used on the face, with no light spots.

Composition/Lens:
Vertical 2:3, the character is located in the center-right of the frame, with the door frame and the boyfriend's clothing edge forming slight obstructions at the foreground edges. 35mm natural perspective, shallow depth of field, with the face, shoulders, and neck clear at the moment of looking back.

Texture/Style:
Contemporary Taiwan cutting-edge documentary style, warm color saturation with an off-axis feel, intimate close-up viewing, restrained grain. The image looks like a frame of Tang Dynasty nightlife recorded casually by a boyfriend, preserving a realistic sense of atmosphere without over-refining.

Negative:
Do not show male characters, no multiple people, no voyeuristic feel, no studio shots, no modern elements, no closed necklines, do not block the collarbone and neck, no facial light spots, no complex gestures, no extra fingers, no deformed hands, no text watermarks.

items.title: 个人资料 / 头像 - Candid Motion Blur Portrait
items.description: An advanced prompt focusing on motion blur and realistic movement for candid photography, maintaining subject identity from a reference image.
items.prompt:
Preserve the subject’s identity and appearance with maximum accuracy. Do not change or reinterpret her facial features, facial proportions, eye shape, nose, lips, jawline, bone structure, skin texture, hair color, hair length, hair density, or natural hair texture. Maintain a highly faithful resemblance to the reference image throughout the scene.

Create a photorealistic candid photograph captured in the middle of natural movement. Use a close-up, waist-up composition. The woman is standing with her back partially toward the camera at the exact moment she quickly turns her head over her shoulder. Her gaze is directed naturally toward something off to the side, as if she has just noticed something behind her. Her expression should feel spontaneous and authentic, not posed or intentionally modeled for the camera.

Natural Motion & Sharpness

The sudden head movement creates realistic, subtle motion blur. Apply gentle blur across the moving face, hair, and individual curls, with slightly softened silhouette edges caused by the speed of the movement. Keep the face sufficiently recognizable and preserve the subject’s defining facial characteristics.

Her curls naturally sweep outward with the movement, creating a believable dynamic trail. The motion should feel like a genuine photograph captured by a real camera with a slightly slower shutter speed—not an artificial blur effect.

Body Language & Composition

Maintain a relaxed, natural posture with subtle asymmetry. The shoulders, neck, and upper body should show believable movement caused by the quick head turn. Avoid fashion-model posing, exaggerated gestures, or stiff studio positioning.

Lighting & Environment

Use cinematic directional lighting with soft, realistic shadows and atmospheric depth. Place the subject in a textured, believable environment with natural visual details. Preserve realistic skin with visible pores, fine texture, and subtle natural imperfections rather than overly smooth or plastic-looking skin.

Camera & Film Aesthetic

Make the image feel as though it was captured on a real 35mm film camera. Include pronounced but natural film grain, subtle optical imperfections, gentle lens characteristics, realistic depth of field, and authentic photographic texture.

Use a muted, low-saturation cinematic color palette with natural tones and restrained contrast. The final image should look like a genuine candid photograph taken in real life—organic, imperfect, cinematic, and completely photorealistic.
